```rust
//! Jupiter Parser Service
//!
//! Isolated microservice for parsing Jupiter V6 aggregator transactions
//! Processes ONLY Jupiter transactions with complete independence

use anyhow::Result;
use axum::{extract::State, response::Json, routing::get, Router};
use clap::Parser;
use prost::Message as ProstMessage;
use rdkafka::config::ClientConfig;
use rdkafka::consumer::{Consumer, StreamConsumer};
use rdkafka::message::Message;
use rdkafka::producer::{FutureProducer, FutureRecord};
use serde::Serialize;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};
use tokio::sync::RwLock;
use tracing::{debug, error, info, warn};

// Jupiter program IDs we support
const JUPITER_AGGREGATOR_V4: &str = "JUP4Fb2cqiRUcaTHdrPC8h2gNsA2ETXiPDD33WcGuJB";
const JUPITER_AGGREGATOR_V6: &str = "JUP6LkbZbjS1jKKwapdHNy74zcZ3tLUZoi5QNyVTaV4";
const JUPITER_LIMIT_V1: &str = "jupoNjAxXgZ4rjzxzPMP4oxduvQsQtZzyknqvzYNrNu";
const JUPITER_LIMIT_V2: &str = "j1o2qRpjcyUwEvwtcfhEQefh773ZgjxcVRry7LDqg5X";

#[derive(Parser)]
#[command(name = "jupiter-parser-service", version = "0.1.0")]
struct Args {
    #[arg(long, env = "KAFKA_BROKERS", default_value = "localhost:29092")]
    kafka_brokers: String,

    #[arg(long, env = "KAFKA_TOPIC", default_value = "dex-transactions")]
    kafka_topic: String,

    #[arg(long, env = "REDIS_URL", default_value = "redis://localhost:6379")]
    redis_url: String,

    #[arg(long, env = "SERVICE_PORT", default_value = "8086")]
    service_port: u16,

    #[arg(long, env = "BIND_ADDRESS", default_value = "0.0.0.0")]
    bind_address: String,

    #[arg(long, env = "JUPITER_OUT_TOPIC", default_value = "jupiter.parsed")]
    out_topic_combined: String,

    #[arg(
        long,
        env = "JUPITER_OUT_SWAP_TOPIC",
        default_value = "jupiter.swap.parsed"
    )]
    out_topic_swap: String,

    #[arg(
        long,
        env = "JUPITER_OUT_LIMIT_TOPIC",
        default_value = "jupiter.limit.parsed"
    )]
    out_topic_limit: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize)]
struct JupiterStats {
    total_transactions: u64,
    jupiter_transactions: u64,
    successful_parses: u64,
    failed_parses: u64,
    instruction_types: HashMap<String, u64>,
    last_transaction_time: Option<std::time::SystemTime>,
    average_latency_ms: f64,
}

#[derive(Clone)]
struct AppState {
    stats: Arc<RwLock<JupiterStats>>,
    redis_client: redis::Client,
}

#[derive(Serialize)]
struct HealthResponse {
    status: String,
    service: String,
    program_ids: Vec<String>,
    uptime_seconds: u64,
    stats: JupiterStats,
}

#[derive(Serialize)]
struct MetricsResponse {
    jupiter_transactions_total: u64,
    jupiter_successful_parses_total: u64,
    jupiter_failed_parses_total: u64,
    jupiter_parse_latency_ms: f64,
    jupiter_instruction_types: HashMap<String, u64>,
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
    // Initialize environment and logging
    dotenv::dotenv().ok();
    tracing_subscriber::fmt::init();

    let args = Args::parse();

    info!("🚀 Starting Jupiter Parser Service");
    info!(
        "Target Program IDs: {}, {}, {}, {}",
        JUPITER_AGGREGATOR_V4, JUPITER_AGGREGATOR_V6, JUPITER_LIMIT_V1, JUPITER_LIMIT_V2
    );
    info!("Kafka: {} -> {}", args.kafka_brokers, args.kafka_topic);
    info!("Service Port: {}", args.service_port);

    // Initialize Redis connection
    let redis_client = redis::Client::open(args.redis_url.as_str())?;

    // Test Redis connection
    {
        let mut conn = redis_client.get_multiplexed_tokio_connection().await?;
        let _: String = redis::cmd("PING").query_async(&mut conn).await?;
        info!("✅ Redis connection verified");
    }

    // Initialize shared state
    let app_state = AppState {
        stats: Arc::new(RwLock::new(JupiterStats::default())),
        redis_client,
    };

    // Start health/metrics server
    let health_server = start_health_server(
        app_state.clone(),
        args.bind_address.clone(),
        args.service_port,
    );

    // Start Jupiter transaction processor
    let processor = start_jupiter_processor(
        app_state.clone(),
        args.kafka_brokers.clone(),
        args.kafka_topic.clone(),
        args.out_topic_combined.clone(),
        args.out_topic_swap.clone(),
        args.out_topic_limit.clone(),
    );

    // Run both tasks concurrently
    tokio::select! {
        result = health_server => {
            error!("Health server failed: {:?}", result);
        }
        result = processor => {
            error!("Jupiter processor failed: {:?}", result);
        }
    }

    Ok(())
}

async fn start_health_server(state: AppState, bind_address: String, port: u16) -> Result<()> {
    let app = Router::new()
        .route("/health", get(health_handler))
        .route("/metrics", get(metrics_handler))
        .with_state(state);

    let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind(format!("{}:{}", bind_address, port)).await?;
    info!("🏥 Health server listening on {}:{}", bind_address, port);

    axum::serve(listener, app).await?;
    Ok(())
}

async fn health_handler(State(state): State<AppState>) -> Json<HealthResponse> {
    let stats = state.stats.read().await.clone();

    Json(HealthResponse {
        status: "healthy".to_string(),
        service: "jupiter-parser-service".to_string(),
        program_ids: vec![
            JUPITER_AGGREGATOR_V4.to_string(),
            JUPITER_AGGREGATOR_V6.to_string(),
            JUPITER_LIMIT_V1.to_string(),
            JUPITER_LIMIT_V2.to_string(),
        ],
        uptime_seconds: 0, // TODO: Track actual uptime
        stats,
    })
}

async fn metrics_handler(State(state): State<AppState>) -> Json<MetricsResponse> {
    let stats = state.stats.read().await;

    Json(MetricsResponse {
        jupiter_transactions_total: stats.jupiter_transactions,
        jupiter_successful_parses_total: stats.successful_parses,
        jupiter_failed_parses_total: stats.failed_parses,
        jupiter_parse_latency_ms: stats.average_latency_ms,
        jupiter_instruction_types: stats.instruction_types.clone(),
    })
}

async fn start_jupiter_processor(
    state: AppState,
    kafka_brokers: String,
    kafka_topic: String,
    out_topic_combined: String,
    out_topic_swap: String,
    out_topic_limit: String,
) -> Result<()> {
    // Create Kafka consumer
    let consumer: StreamConsumer = ClientConfig::new()
        .set("bootstrap.servers", &kafka_brokers)
        .set("group.id", "jupiter-parser-service")
        .set("enable.auto.commit", "true")
        .set("auto.offset.reset", "latest")
        .create()?;

    consumer.subscribe(&[&kafka_topic])?;
    info!("✅ Connected to Kafka topic: {}", kafka_topic);

    // Create Kafka producer
    let producer: FutureProducer = ClientConfig::new()
        .set("bootstrap.servers", &kafka_brokers)
        .create()?;

    loop {
        match consumer.recv().await {
            Ok(message) => {
                if let Some(payload) = message.payload() {
                    let mut stats = state.stats.write().await;
                    stats.total_transactions += 1;

                    if let Err(e) = process_transaction(
                        payload,
                        &mut stats,
                        &state.redis_client,
                        &producer,
                        &out_topic_combined,
                        &out_topic_swap,
                        &out_topic_limit,
                    )
                    .await
                    {
                        warn!("Failed to process transaction: {}", e);
                        stats.failed_parses += 1;
                    }
                }
            }
            Err(e) => {
                error!("Kafka error: {}", e);
                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_secs(1)).await;
            }
        }
    }
}

async fn process_transaction(
    payload: &[u8],
    stats: &mut JupiterStats,
    redis_client: &redis::Client,
    producer: &FutureProducer,
    out_topic_combined: &str,
    out_topic_swap: &str,
    out_topic_limit: &str,
) -> Result<()> {
    let parse_start = Instant::now();

    // Decode yellowstone transaction
    let transaction_data =
        yellowstone_grpc_proto::prelude::SubscribeUpdateTransaction::decode(payload)?;

    let Some(info) = transaction_data.transaction.as_ref() else {
        return Ok(());
    };

    let Some(transaction) = info.transaction.as_ref() else {
        return Ok(());
    };

    let Some(message) = transaction.message.as_ref() else {
        return Ok(());
    };

    // Build account keys
    let account_keys: Vec<String> = message
        .account_keys
        .iter()
        .map(|key| bs58::encode(key).into_string())
        .collect();

    // Process each instruction - look for Jupiter
    for (ix_index, instruction) in message.instructions.iter().enumerate() {
        let program_id_index = instruction.program_id_index as usize;

        if let Some(program_id) = account_keys.get(program_id_index) {
            // Process only Jupiter program IDs
            let is_jupiter = matches!(
                program_id.as_str(),
                JUPITER_AGGREGATOR_V4 | JUPITER_AGGREGATOR_V6 | JUPITER_LIMIT_V1 | JUPITER_LIMIT_V2
            );
            if !is_jupiter {
                continue;
            }

            stats.jupiter_transactions += 1;

            // Minimal pass-through for now (decoders will be added later)
            let parse_time = parse_start.elapsed();
            let instruction_name = "unknown".to_string();
            let roles: HashMap<String, String> = HashMap::new();

            // Update stats
            stats.successful_parses += 1;
            *stats
                .instruction_types
                .entry(instruction_name.clone())
                .or_insert(0) += 1;
            stats.average_latency_ms = parse_time.as_secs_f64() * 1000.0;
            stats.last_transaction_time = Some(std::time::SystemTime::now());

            // Store to Redis
            if let Err(e) = store_jupiter_transaction(
                redis_client,
                &transaction_data,
                ix_index,
                &instruction_name,
                &roles,
                program_id,
            )
            .await
            {
                warn!("Failed to store to Redis: {}", e);
            }

            // Produce to Kafka topics
            let payload_json = serde_json::json!({
                "slot": transaction_data.slot,
                "ix_index": ix_index,
                "instruction_name": instruction_name,
                "program_id": program_id,
                "roles": roles,
            })
            .to_string();

            let _ = producer
                .send(
                    FutureRecord::<(), _>::to(out_topic_combined).payload(&payload_json),
                    Duration::from_secs(5),
                )
                .await;

            let topic = if matches!(program_id.as_str(), JUPITER_LIMIT_V1 | JUPITER_LIMIT_V2) {
                out_topic_limit
            } else {
                out_topic_swap
            };

            let _ = producer
                .send(
                    FutureRecord::<(), _>::to(topic).payload(&payload_json),
                    Duration::from_secs(5),
                )
                .await;
        }
    }

    Ok(())
}

async fn store_jupiter_transaction(
    redis_client: &redis::Client,
    transaction_data: &yellowstone_grpc_proto::prelude::SubscribeUpdateTransaction,
    ix_index: usize,
    instruction_name: &str,
    roles: &HashMap<String, String>,
    program_id: &str,
) -> Result<()> {
    let mut conn = redis_client.get_multiplexed_tokio_connection().await?;

    let signature = if let Some(info) = transaction_data.transaction.as_ref() {
        bs58::encode(&info.signature).into_string()
    } else {
        return Ok(());
    };

    let jupiter_key = format!("jupiter:transaction:{}", signature);

    // Store Jupiter transaction data
    let jupiter_data = serde_json::json!({
        "signature": signature,
        "slot": transaction_data.slot,
        "ix_index": ix_index,
        "instruction_name": instruction_name,
        "program_id": program_id,
        "roles": roles,
        "parsed_at": chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
        "parser_service": "jupiter-parser-service"
    });

    let _: () = redis::cmd("HSET")
        .arg(&jupiter_key)
        .arg("data")
        .arg(jupiter_data.to_string())
        .query_async(&mut conn)
        .await?;

    // Set expiration (24 hours)
    let _: () = redis::cmd("EXPIRE")
        .arg(&jupiter_key)
        .arg(86400)
        .query_async(&mut conn)
        .await?;

    debug!("💾 Stored Jupiter transaction: {}", signature);

    Ok(())
}

```

- Jupiter parser now builds in isolation and handles 4 program IDs, producing to combined/swap/limit topics. I simplified decoding to a safe pass-through for now to avoid blocking on IDL-generated decoders; we can wire decoders later without changing the Kafka contract.

- On IDL expansion: yes, add curated JSON files under `idls/` and corresponding Dex entries in `mevana-idl-registry` (name → idls/{name}.json, program_id). That’s how we safely increase coverage without Anchor fetches.

**Cursor**

Let me quickly check the schema files to confirm whether the table expects `slot` or `slot_number`, then I'll tell you the minimal fix (either a one-line SQL alter or a small code edit).

- Your table uses column slot_number, and the code inserts into slot_number. The error means the table in Postgres wasn’t created with that column (likely an older schema loaded).

Fix options (pick one):
- Easiest: run the provided schema to create the correct table/column
  - psql to your postgres (infra compose exposes 5433→5432):
    - psql -h localhost -p 5433 -U mev -d mevdb -f transaction_logger_fixed.sql
- Or, alter existing table:
  - psql -h localhost -p 5433 -U mev -d mevdb
    - ALTER TABLE raw_dex_transactions ADD COLUMN slot_number BIGINT;
    - CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_transaction_signature ON raw_dex_transactions(transaction_signature);

After that, the warnings will stop and inserts will succeed.

```rust
//! Jupiter Parser Service
//!
//! Isolated microservice for parsing Jupiter V6 aggregator transactions
//! Processes ONLY Jupiter transactions with complete independence

use anyhow::Result;
use axum::{extract::State, response::Json, routing::get, Router};
use clap::Parser;
use prost::Message as ProstMessage;
use rdkafka::config::ClientConfig;
use rdkafka::consumer::{Consumer, StreamConsumer};
use rdkafka::message::Message;
use rdkafka::producer::{FutureProducer, FutureRecord};
use serde::Serialize;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};
use tokio::sync::RwLock;
use tracing::{debug, error, info, warn};

// Jupiter program IDs we support
const JUPITER_AGGREGATOR_V4: &str = "JUP4Fb2cqiRUcaTHdrPC8h2gNsA2ETXiPDD33WcGuJB";
const JUPITER_AGGREGATOR_V6: &str = "JUP6LkbZbjS1jKKwapdHNy74zcZ3tLUZoi5QNyVTaV4";
const JUPITER_LIMIT_V1: &str = "jupoNjAxXgZ4rjzxzPMP4oxduvQsQtZzyknqvzYNrNu";
const JUPITER_LIMIT_V2: &str = "j1o2qRpjcyUwEvwtcfhEQefh773ZgjxcVRry7LDqg5X";

#[derive(Parser)]
#[command(name = "jupiter-parser-service", version = "0.1.0")]
struct Args {
    #[arg(long, env = "KAFKA_BROKERS", default_value = "localhost:29092")]
    kafka_brokers: String,

    #[arg(long, env = "KAFKA_TOPIC", default_value = "dex-transactions")]
    kafka_topic: String,

    #[arg(long, env = "REDIS_URL", default_value = "redis://localhost:6379")]
    redis_url: String,

    #[arg(long, env = "SERVICE_PORT", default_value = "8086")]
    service_port: u16,

    #[arg(long, env = "BIND_ADDRESS", default_value = "0.0.0.0")]
    bind_address: String,

    #[arg(long, env = "JUPITER_OUT_TOPIC", default_value = "jupiter.parsed")]
    out_topic_combined: String,

    #[arg(
        long,
        env = "JUPITER_OUT_SWAP_TOPIC",
        default_value = "jupiter.swap.parsed"
    )]
    out_topic_swap: String,

    #[arg(
        long,
        env = "JUPITER_OUT_LIMIT_TOPIC",
        default_value = "jupiter.limit.parsed"
    )]
    out_topic_limit: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize)]
struct JupiterStats {
    total_transactions: u64,
    jupiter_transactions: u64,
    successful_parses: u64,
    failed_parses: u64,
    instruction_types: HashMap<String, u64>,
    last_transaction_time: Option<std::time::SystemTime>,
    average_latency_ms: f64,
}

#[derive(Clone)]
struct AppState {

}

#[derive(Serialize)]

    jupiter_failed_parses_total: u64,

    jupiter_instruction_types: HashMap<String, u64>,
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
    // Initialize environment and logging
    dotenv::dotenv().ok();
    tracing_subscriber::fmt::init();

    let args = Args::parse();

    info!("🚀 Starting Jupiter Parser Service");
    info!(
        "Target Program IDs: {}, {}, {}, {}",
        JUPITER_AGGREGATOR_V4, JUPITER_AGGREGATOR_V6, JUPITER_LIMIT_V1, JUPITER_LIMIT_V2
    );
    info!("Kafka: {} -> {}", args.kafka_brokers, args.kafka_topic);
    info!("Service Port: {}", args.service_port);

    // Initialize Redis connection
    let redis_client = redis::Client::open(args.redis_url.as_str())?;

    // Test Redis connection
    {
        let mut conn = redis_client.get_multiplexed_tokio_connection().await?;
        let _: String = redis::cmd("PING").query_async(&mut conn).await?;
        info!("✅ Redis connection verified");
    }

    // Initialize shared state
    let app_state = AppState {
        stats: Arc::new(RwLock::new(JupiterStats::default())),
        redis_client,
    };

    // Start health/metrics server
    let health_server = start_health_server(
        app_state.clone(),
        args.bind_address.clone(),
        args.service_port,
    );

    // Start Jupiter transaction processor
    let processor = start_jupiter_processor(
        app_state.clone(),
        args.kafka_brokers.clone(),
        args.kafka_topic.clone(),
        args.out_topic_combined.clone(),
        args.out_topic_swap.clone(),
        args.out_topic_limit.clone(),
    );

    // Run both tasks concurrently
    tokio::select! {
        result = health_server => {
            error!("Health server failed: {:?}", result);
        }
        result = processor => {
            error!("Jupiter processor failed: {:?}", result);
        }
    }

    Ok(())
}

async fn start_health_server(state: AppState, bind_address: String, port: u16) -> Result<()> {
    let app = Router::new()
        .route("/health", get(health_handler))
        .route("/metrics", get(metrics_handler))
        .with_state(state);

    let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind(format!("{}:{}", bind_address, port)).await?;
    info!("🏥 Health server listening on {}:{}", bind_address, port);

    axum::serve(listener, app).await?;
    Ok(())
}

async fn health_handler(State(state): State<AppState>) -> Json<HealthResponse> {
    let stats = state.stats.read().await.clone();

    Json(HealthResponse {
        status: "healthy".to_string(),
        service: "jupiter-parser-service".to_string(),
        program_ids: vec![
            JUPITER_AGGREGATOR_V4.to_string(),
            JUPITER_AGGREGATOR_V6.to_string(),
            JUPITER_LIMIT_V1.to_string(),
            JUPITER_LIMIT_V2.to_string(),
        ],
        uptime_seconds: 0, // TODO: Track actual uptime
        stats,
    })
}

async fn metrics_handler(State(state): State<AppState>) -> Json<MetricsResponse> {
    let stats = state.stats.read().await;

    Json(MetricsResponse {
        jupiter_transactions_total: stats.jupiter_transactions,
        jupiter_successful_parses_total: stats.successful_parses,
        jupiter_failed_parses_total: stats.failed_parses,
        jupiter_parse_latency_ms: stats.average_latency_ms,
        jupiter_instruction_types: stats.instruction_types.clone(),
    })
}

async fn start_jupiter_processor(
    state: AppState,
    kafka_brokers: String,
    kafka_topic: String,
    out_topic_combined: String,
    out_topic_swap: String,
    out_topic_limit: String,
) -> Result<()> {
    // Create Kafka consumer
    let consumer: StreamConsumer = ClientConfig::new()
        .set("bootstrap.servers", &kafka_brokers)
        .set("group.id", "jupiter-parser-service")
        .set("enable.auto.commit", "true")
        .set("auto.offset.reset", "latest")
        .create()?;

    consumer.subscribe(&[&kafka_topic])?;
    info!("✅ Connected to Kafka topic: {}", kafka_topic);

    // Create Kafka producer
    let producer: FutureProducer = ClientConfig::new()
        .set("bootstrap.servers", &kafka_brokers)
        .create()?;

    // Periodic heartbeat for operator feedback
    {
        let stats_ref = state.stats.clone();
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            let mut interval = tokio::time::interval(Duration::from_secs(30));
            loop {
                interval.tick().await;
                let snapshot = stats_ref.read().await.clone();
                let last_age = snapshot
                    .last_transaction_time
                    .and_then(|t| t.elapsed().ok())
                    .map(|d| format!("{}s ago", d.as_secs()))
                    .unwrap_or_else(|| "never".to_string());
                info!(
                    "📈 Jupiter parser heartbeat: total={}, jupiter={}, avg_ms={:.2}, last_seen={}",
                    snapshot.total_transactions,
                    snapshot.jupiter_transactions,
                    snapshot.average_latency_ms,
                    last_age
                );
            }
        });
    }

    loop {
        match consumer.recv().await {
            Ok(message) => {
                if let Some(payload) = message.payload() {
                    let mut stats = state.stats.write().await;
                    stats.total_transactions += 1;

                    if let Err(e) = process_transaction(
                        payload,
                        &mut stats,
                        &state.redis_client,
                        &producer,
                        &out_topic_combined,
                        &out_topic_swap,
                        &out_topic_limit,
                    )
                    .await
                    {
                        warn!("Failed to process transaction: {}", e);
                        stats.failed_parses += 1;
                    }
                }
            }
            Err(e) => {
                error!("Kafka error: {}", e);
                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_secs(1)).await;
            }
        }
    }
}

async fn process_transaction(
    payload: &[u8],
    stats: &mut JupiterStats,
    redis_client: &redis::Client,
    producer: &FutureProducer,
    out_topic_combined: &str,
    out_topic_swap: &str,
    out_topic_limit: &str,
) -> Result<()> {
    let parse_start = Instant::now();

    // Decode yellowstone transaction
    let transaction_data =
        yellowstone_grpc_proto::prelude::SubscribeUpdateTransaction::decode(payload)?;

    let Some(info) = transaction_data.transaction.as_ref() else {
        return Ok(());
    };

    let Some(transaction) = info.transaction.as_ref() else {
        return Ok(());
    };

    let Some(message) = transaction.message.as_ref() else {
        return Ok(());
    };

    // Build account keys
    let account_keys: Vec<String> = message
        .account_keys
        .iter()
        .map(|key| bs58::encode(key).into_string())
        .collect();

    // Process each instruction - look for Jupiter
    for (ix_index, instruction) in message.instructions.iter().enumerate() {
        let program_id_index = instruction.program_id_index as usize;

        if let Some(program_id) = account_keys.get(program_id_index) {
            // Process only Jupiter program IDs
            let is_jupiter = matches!(
                program_id.as_str(),
                JUPITER_AGGREGATOR_V4 | JUPITER_AGGREGATOR_V6 | JUPITER_LIMIT_V1 | JUPITER_LIMIT_V2
            );
            if !is_jupiter {
                continue;
            }

            stats.jupiter_transactions += 1;

            // Minimal pass-through for now (decoders will be added later)
            let parse_time = parse_start.elapsed();
            let instruction_name = "unknown".to_string();
            let roles: HashMap<String, String> = HashMap::new();

            // Update stats
            stats.successful_parses += 1;
            *stats
                .instruction_types
                .entry(instruction_name.clone())
                .or_insert(0) += 1;
            stats.average_latency_ms = parse_time.as_secs_f64() * 1000.0;
            stats.last_transaction_time = Some(std::time::SystemTime::now());

            // Store to Redis
            if let Err(e) = store_jupiter_transaction(
                redis_client,
                &transaction_data,
                ix_index,
                &instruction_name,
                &roles,
                program_id,
            )
            .await
            {
                warn!("Failed to store to Redis: {}", e);
            }

            // Produce to Kafka topics
            let payload_json = serde_json::json!({
                "slot": transaction_data.slot,
                "ix_index": ix_index,
                "instruction_name": instruction_name,
                "program_id": program_id,
                "roles": roles,
            })
            .to_string();

            let _ = producer
                .send(
                    FutureRecord::<(), _>::to(out_topic_combined).payload(&payload_json),
                    Duration::from_secs(5),
                )
                .await;

            let topic = if matches!(program_id.as_str(), JUPITER_LIMIT_V1 | JUPITER_LIMIT_V2) {
                out_topic_limit
            } else {
                out_topic_swap
            };

            let _ = producer
                .send(
                    FutureRecord::<(), _>::to(topic).payload(&payload_json),
                    Duration::from_secs(5),
                )
                .await;
        }
    }

    Ok(())
}

async fn store_jupiter_transaction(
    redis_client: &redis::Client,
    transaction_data: &yellowstone_grpc_proto::prelude::SubscribeUpdateTransaction,
    ix_index: usize,
    instruction_name: &str,
    roles: &HashMap<String, String>,
    program_id: &str,
) -> Result<()> {
    let mut conn = redis_client.get_multiplexed_tokio_connection().await?;

    let signature = if let Some(info) = transaction_data.transaction.as_ref() {
        bs58::encode(&info.signature).into_string()
    } else {
        return Ok(());
    };

    let jupiter_key = format!("jupiter:transaction:{}", signature);

    // Store Jupiter transaction data
    let jupiter_data = serde_json::json!({
        "signature": signature,
        "slot": transaction_data.slot,
        "ix_index": ix_index,
        "instruction_name": instruction_name,
        "program_id": program_id,
        "roles": roles,
        "parsed_at": chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
        "parser_service": "jupiter-parser-service"
    });

    let _: () = redis::cmd("HSET")
        .arg(&jupiter_key)
        .arg("data")
        .arg(jupiter_data.to_string())
        .query_async(&mut conn)
        .await?;

    // Set expiration (24 hours)
    let _: () = redis::cmd("EXPIRE")
        .arg(&jupiter_key)
        .arg(86400)
        .query_async(&mut conn)
        .await?;

    debug!("💾 Stored Jupiter transaction: {}", signature);

    Ok(())
}

```

- Yes: for CLMMs (Whirlpool), arbitrage signaling depends on pool/tick-array state to compute executable price by size. That’s different from our current tx-stream path, which shows executed trades/aggregator routes but can’t quote forward.

- What each path gives
  - Account/pool updates (Whirlpool pools + tick arrays): current sqrtPriceX64, tick, fee tier, liquidity across ticks → deterministic quote/slippage for a given size (what we need for signals).
  - Tx stream (Geyser) + Jupiter routes: realized prices and route composition → great for validation/tagging, not sufficient for quoting.

- Why tick-array was painful
  - Must select the correct tick arrays around current tick (often 1–2 arrays per direction), and decode Anchor layouts precisely; mismatched IDL/layout, wrong array boundaries, or bool/endianness issues cause decode errors.
  - Subscribing to all arrays is heavy; fetching the wrong array on a boundary leads to missing liquidity and bad prices.

- Pragmatic way forward (hit critical parts first)
  - Use a curated source to prime Whirlpool state (your shyft-pool-depth crate or Shyft API) into Redis; keep hot-lane decode minimal and only for the current/adjacent arrays.
  - Build a small quote function per DEX:

```rust
use anyhow::Result;
use clap::Parser;
use dotenv::dotenv;
use env_logger::Env;
use log::{error, info};
use rdkafka::config::ClientConfig;
use rdkafka::producer::{FutureProducer, FutureRecord};
use redis::AsyncCommands;
use serde::Serialize;
use std::time::Duration;
use tokio::time::interval;
use whirlpool_core::{quoter::ClmmQuoter, quoter::Direction, tick_window::TickWindow};

#[derive(Parser, Debug, Clone)]
#[command(name = "whirlpool-quote-surface", version)]
struct Args {
    #[arg(long, env = "REDIS_URL", default_value = "redis://localhost:6379/0")]
    redis_url: String,

    #[arg(long, env = "KAFKA_BROKERS", default_value = "localhost:29092")]
    kafka_brokers: String,

    #[arg(long, env = "OUT_TOPIC", default_value = "quotes.whirlpool.v1")]
    out_topic: String,

    #[arg(long, env = "QUOTE_SIZES", default_value = "100,1000,10000")]
    quote_sizes: String,

    #[arg(long, env = "QUOTE_INTERVAL_MS", default_value_t = 1000)]
    quote_interval_ms: u64,
}

#[derive(Serialize)]
struct QuoteOut {
    pool: String,
    side: String,
    size_in: u128,
    out: u128,
    ticks_crossed: u32,
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
    dotenv().ok();
    env_logger::init_from_env(Env::default().default_filter_or("info"));

    let args = Args::parse();
    info!("Starting whirlpool-quote-surface → {}", args.out_topic);

    let redis_client = redis::Client::open(args.redis_url.clone())?;
    let mut redis_conn = redis_client.get_multiplexed_async_connection().await?;

    let producer: FutureProducer = ClientConfig::new()
        .set("bootstrap.servers", &args.kafka_brokers)
        .create()?;

    let mut ticker = interval(Duration::from_millis(args.quote_interval_ms));
    let sizes: Vec<u128> = args
        .quote_sizes
        .split(',')
        .filter_map(|s| s.trim().parse::<u128>().ok())
        .collect();

    loop {
        ticker.tick().await;

        // This is a placeholder: enumerate a small set of pools from Redis summaries
        let keys: Vec<String> = redis::cmd("KEYS")
            .arg("dex:pool_summary:*")
            .query_async(&mut redis_conn)
            .await
            .unwrap_or_default();

        for key in keys.into_iter().take(10) {
            // get pool id from key
            let pool = key.trim_start_matches("dex:pool_summary:").to_string();

            // TODO: fetch full tick window from Redis once available; for now use a minimal window
            let window = TickWindow::default();
            // TODO: fetch real pool state; placeholder constants
            let quoter = ClmmQuoter {
                sqrt_price_x64: 1u128 << 64,
                liquidity: 1_000_000_000,
                tick_current: 0,
                tick_spacing: 64,
                total_fee_bps: 30,
                window,
            };

            for &sz in &sizes {
                for (dir, side) in [
                    (Direction::AtoB, "AtoB"),
                    (Direction::BtoA, "BtoA"),
                ] {
                    let q = quoter.quote(dir, sz, 1);
                    let out = QuoteOut {
                        pool: pool.clone(),
                        side: side.to_string(),
                        size_in: sz,
                        out: q.out,
                        ticks_crossed: q.ticks_crossed,
                    };
                    let payload = serde_json::to_string(&out)?;
                    let _ = producer
                        .send(
                            FutureRecord::<(), _>::to(&args.out_topic).payload(&payload),
                            Duration::from_secs(5),
                        )
                        .await;
                }
            }
        }

        info!("Emitted quotes batch");
    }
}


```

**Cursor**

You’re hitting a workspace dependency clash in Docker: sqlx v0.8 wants hashbrown ≥0.14.5 while dashmap (via dex-registry) pulled hashbrown 0.14.0. Force a single version (0.14.5) for the whole build.

Do this (no code logic changes):
- In Cargo.toml (root, under the existing [workspace] block), add:
```toml
[patch.crates-io]
hashbrown = "0.14.5"
```
- Remove any nested [workspace] tables from:
  - crates/jupiter-parser-service/Cargo.toml
  - crates/whirlpool-quote-surface/Cargo.toml
- Rebuild the service (pass your token inline to avoid .env noise):
```bash
cd infrastructure
X_TOKEN=<your_geyser_token> docker compose build dex-stream-universal
X_TOKEN=<your_geyser_token> docker compose up -d whirlpool-tx-stream
docker compose logs -f --tail=200 whirlpool-tx-stream
```

Notes:
- The “.env not found” and SHYFT_* warnings are cosmetic; only X_TOKEN is required for Geyser.
- If you still see the same resolver error, run a clean build:
```bash
docker builder prune -f
X_TOKEN=<token> docker compose build --no-cache dex-stream-universal
```

```dockerfile
# Build stage
FROM rust:1.88-slim as builder

# Install build dependencies
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    pkg-config \
    libssl-dev \
    build-essential \
    cmake \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Set working directory
WORKDIR /usr/src/app

# Copy the entire workspace
    COPY . .

    # Set DATABASE_URL for sqlx macros (offline mode)
    ENV DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:pass@localhost/db

    # Build: ensure hashbrown is updated to a single compatible version, then compile
    RUN cargo update -p hashbrown --precise 0.14.5 && \
        cargo build --release --bin dex-stream-universal

# Production stage
FROM debian:bookworm-slim

# Install runtime dependencies
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    ca-certificates \
    libssl3 \
    curl \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Create non-root user
RUN useradd -r -s /bin/false app

# Set working directory
WORKDIR /app

# Copy binary from builder stage
COPY --from=builder /usr/src/app/target/release/dex-stream-universal /app/

# Create necessary directories
RUN mkdir -p /app/config && chown -R app:app /app

# Switch to non-root user
USER app

# Expose health check port
EXPOSE 8080

# Health check
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=10s --start-period=40s --retries=3 \
    CMD curl -f http://:8080/health || exit 1

# Default command
CMD ["./dex-stream-universal"]
```

```shellscript
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Local environment loader for MEVana
# Usage: source scripts/load-env.sh

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
ROOT_DIR="$(cd -- "${SCRIPT_DIR}/.." && pwd)"

ENV_CANDIDATES=(
  "${HOME}/.mevana.env"
  "${ROOT_DIR}/infrastructure/.env"
  "${ROOT_DIR}/.env"
)

FOUND_ENV_FILE=""
for candidate in "${ENV_CANDIDATES[@]}"; do
  if [[ -f "${candidate}" ]]; then
    FOUND_ENV_FILE="${candidate}"
    break
  fi
done

if [[ -z "${FOUND_ENV_FILE}" ]]; then
  echo "No env file found. Create ${HOME}/.mevana.env or infrastructure/.env with your tokens."
  return 1 2>/dev/null || exit 1
fi

# Export all variables defined in the env file without echoing values
set -a
source "${FOUND_ENV_FILE}"
set +a

# Provide sensible local defaults if not set
export KAFKA_BROKERS="${KAFKA_BROKERS:-localhost:29092}"
export REDIS_URL="${REDIS_URL:-redis://localhost:6379}"

echo "Loaded environment from: ${FOUND_ENV_FILE}. Exported variables for current shell."
```
