```dockercompose
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://:8084/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 40s
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 128M
          cpus: '0.10'

  # Test environment configuration
  dex-stream-universal-test:
    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: crates/dex-stream-universal/Dockerfile
    profiles: ["test"]
    container_name: dex_stream_universal_test
    depends_on:
      kafka:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      # Core service configuration
      - RUST_LOG=info
      - KAFKA_BROKER=kafka:9092
      - TOPIC=dex-transactions
      - ENDPOINT=https://grpc.ny.shyft.to
      - X_TOKEN=${TEST_X_TOKEN:-efff2d23-97ae-4c5f-8b8b-9a6265001189}
      - HEALTH_PORT=8084
      - BIND_ADDRESS=0.0.0.0
      - DEX_FILTERING=OFF
      - PROGRAM_IDS=whirLbMiicVdio4qvUfM5KAg6Ct8VwpYzGff3uctyCc
    ports:
      - "8084:8084"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://:8084/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 40s
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 128M
          cpus: '0.10'

  # Production environment configuration
  dex-stream-universal-prod:
    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: crates/dex-stream-universal/Dockerfile
    profiles: ["prod"]
    container_name: dex_stream_universal_prod
    depends_on:
      kafka:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      # Core service configuration
      - RUST_LOG=warn
      - KAFKA_BROKER=kafka:9092
      - TOPIC=dex-transactions
      - ENDPOINT=https://grpc.ny.shyft.to
      - X_TOKEN=${PROD_X_TOKEN:-efff2d23-97ae-4c5f-8b8b-9a6265001189}
      - HEALTH_PORT=8084
      - BIND_ADDRESS=0.0.0.0
      - DEX_FILTERING=ON
      - PROGRAM_IDS=whirLbMiicVdio4qvUfM5KAg6Ct8VwpYzGff3uctyCc
    ports:
      - "8084:8084"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://:8084/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 40s
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 128M
          cpus: '0.10'
  # Whirlpool TX stream (reuses dex-stream-universal with Whirlpool program filter)
  # NOTE: TX-only; does NOT stream tick arrays. Safe to run alongside the universal stream.
  whirlpool-tx-stream:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: crates/dex-stream-universal/Dockerfile.slim
    container_name: whirlpool-tx-stream
    depends_on:
      kafka:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      - RUST_LOG=info
      - KAFKA_BROKER=kafka:9092
      - TOPIC=dex-transactions
      - ENDPOINT=https://grpc.ny.shyft.to
      - X_TOKEN=${X_TOKEN}
      - HEALTH_PORT=8091   # 8084 is reserved; use a free port
      - BIND_ADDRESS=0.0.0.0
      - DEX_FILTERING=ON
      # Whirlpool program ID only — keeps TX stream focused
      - PROGRAM_IDS=whirLbMiicVdio4qvUfM5KAg6Ct8VwpYzGff3uctyCc
    ports:
      - "8091:8091"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
          limits:
            memory: 256M
            cpus: '0.25'
          reservations:
            memory: 128M
            cpus: '0.10'

  # Jupiter TX stream (reuses dex-stream-universal with Jupiter program filters)
  # NOTE: TX-only; does NOT stream tick arrays. Emits raw Jupiter TXs to dex-transactions.
  jupiter-tx-stream:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: crates/dex-stream-universal/Dockerfile.slim
    container_name: jupiter-tx-stream
    depends_on:
      kafka:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      - RUST_LOG=info
      - KAFKA_BROKER=kafka:9092
      - TOPIC=dex-transactions
      - ENDPOINT=${ENDPOINT}
      - X_TOKEN=${X_TOKEN}
      - HEALTH_PORT=8092   # 8084 reserved; 8091 used by whirlpool
      - BIND_ADDRESS=0.0.0.0
      - DEX_FILTERING=ON
      # Jupiter program IDs: aggregator v4, aggregator v6, limit v1, limit v2
      - PROGRAM_IDS=JUP4Fb2cqiRUcaTHdrPC8h2gNsA2ETXiPDD33WcGuJB,JUP6LkbZbjS1jKKwapdHNy74zcZ3tLUZoi5QNyVTaV4,jupoNjAxXgZ4rjzxzPMP4oxduvQsQtZzyknqvzYNrNu,j1o2qRpjcyUwEvwtcfhEQefh773ZgjxcVRry7LDqg5X
    ports:
      - "8092:8092"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
          limits:
            memory: 256M
            cpus: '0.25'
          reservations:
            memory: 128M
            cpus: '0.10'
  # GRAPHQL-BACKFILL SERVICE - Historical data processing
  # =====================================================
  # This service fetches historical data from Shyft's GraphQL API
  # and stores it in Redis for quick retrieval.
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Redis being healthy.
  # It will not start until Redis is ready to accept connections.
  graphql-backfill:
    build:
      context: ../../crates/graphql-backfill
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    image: graphql-backfill:latest
    container_name: graphql-backfill
    environment:
      # Shyft API key for authentication
      - SHYFT_API_KEY=${SHYFT_API_KEY}
      # Shyft network (e.g., mainnet-beta, devnet)
      - SHYFT_NETWORK=${SHYFT_NETWORK:-mainnet-beta}
      # Redis connection string
      - REDIS_URL=${REDIS_URL:-redis://redis:6379/0}
      # Pagination parameters for data fetching
      - PAGE_SIZE=${PAGE_SIZE:-250}
      - MAX_PAGES=${MAX_PAGES:-200}
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: "no"
    command: ["--page-size","250","--max-pages","200"]

  # DEX-BACKFILL SERVICE - Solana DEX Data Backfill
  # ===============================================
  # This service fetches historical DEX data (swaps, positions)
  # from Solana's RPC and stores it in Redis.
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Redis being healthy.
  # It will not start until Redis is ready to accept connections.
  dex-backfill:
    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: crates/dex-backfill/Dockerfile
    image: dex-backfill:latest
    container_name: dex-backfill
    environment:
      # Shyft RPC endpoint and token for data fetching
      - ENDPOINT=${SHYFT_GRPC_ENDPOINT}
      - X_TOKEN=${SHYFT_GRPC_TOKEN}
      # Redis connection string
      - REDIS_URL=${REDIS_URL:-redis://redis:6379/0}
      # Include tick arrays and positions in backfill
      - INCLUDE_TICKARRAYS=${INCLUDE_TICKARRAYS:-true}
      - INCLUDE_POSITIONS=${INCLUDE_POSITIONS:-true}
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: ["--include-tickarrays","--include-positions"]
    volumes:
      - ../../crates/dex-backfill/idls:/app/idls
      - ../../crates/dex-backfill/scripts:/app/scripts:ro

  # NORMALIZER-SERVICE-EXTRACTOR - Data Normalization & Performance Monitoring
  # ======================================================================
  # This service consumes raw Kafka messages and normalizes
  # them into a consistent format for downstream processing.
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Kafka and Redis being healthy.
  # It will not start until both are ready.
  #
  # PERFORMANCE MONITORING:
  # - Parsing accuracy metrics
  # - Processing speed (messages/second)
  # - Error rates and types
  # - Memory and CPU usage
  # - Kafka consumer lag
  normalizer-service-extractor:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: crates/normalizer-service/Dockerfile
    container_name: normalizer-service-extractor
    depends_on:
      kafka:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      # Core service configuration
      - RUST_LOG=info
      # Kafka broker connection
      - KAFKA_BROKER=kafka:9092
      # Input topic for raw data (from dex-stream-universal)
      - IN_TOPIC=dex-transactions
      # Output topic for normalized data
      - OUT_TOPIC=orca-swaps.parsed.v2
      # Consumer group ID for message consumption
      - GROUP_ID=tap-orca-extract
      # Redis connection string
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379/0
      # Health monitoring port
      - HEALTH_PORT=8085
      - BIND_ADDRESS=0.0.0.0
      # Fast mode for quicker development
      - FAST_MODE=1
      # TTL for mint decimals cache
      - MINT_DECIMALS_TTL_MS=60000
      # TTL for pool snapshot cache
      - POOL_SNAPSHOT_TTL_MS=60000
      # Debug mode for full transaction output
      - DEBUG_MODE=1
      - DEBUG_TOPIC=normalizer-debug-full-tx
    ports:
      - "8085:8085"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://:8085/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 40s
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'

  # NORMALIZER-SERVICE-DEBUG - Full Transaction Debug Output
  # ========================================================
  # This service outputs the complete, prettified JSON of raw transactions
  # for development and analysis purposes.
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Kafka being healthy.
  # It will not start until Kafka is ready.
  #
  # OUTPUT: Full transaction JSON with all instructions, accounts, and metadata
  # LABELED: "FULL_TRANSACTION_DEBUG_OUTPUT" for easy identification
  normalizer-service-debug:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: crates/normalizer-service/Dockerfile
    container_name: normalizer-service-debug
    depends_on:
      kafka:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      # Core service configuration
      - RUST_LOG=info
      # Kafka broker connection
      - KAFKA_BROKER=kafka:9092
      # Input topic for raw data (from dex-stream-universal)
      - IN_TOPIC=dex-transactions
      # Debug topic for full transaction output
      - DEBUG_TOPIC=normalizer-debug-full-tx
      # Consumer group ID for message consumption
      - GROUP_ID=tap-orca-debug
    entrypoint: ["/usr/local/bin/tap_orca_debug"]
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 128M
          cpus: '0.10'

  # SHYFT-TRANSACTION-FETCHER - Shyft API Transaction Data
  # ======================================================
  # This service fetches decoded transactions from Shyft API and sends them to Kafka
  # for comparison with our debug output.
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Kafka being healthy.
  # It will not start until Kafka is ready.
  #
  # OUTPUT: Complete Shyft API parsed transaction data in prettified JSON
  # LABELED: "SHYFT_API_COMPLETE_TRANSACTION_PARSED" for easy identification
  shyft-transaction-fetcher:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: crates/shyft-transaction-fetcher/Dockerfile
    container_name: shyft-transaction-fetcher
    depends_on:
      kafka:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      # Core service configuration
      - RUST_LOG=info
      # Shyft API configuration
      - SHYFT_API_KEY=${SHYFT_API_KEY}
      - SHYFT_NETWORK=mainnet-beta
      # Kafka broker connection
      - KAFKA_BROKER=kafka:9092
      # Output topic for Shyft transaction data
      - OUTPUT_TOPIC=shyft-transactions-parsed
      # Health check configuration
      - HEALTH_PORT=8087
      - BIND_ADDRESS=0.0.0.0
    # Example: Fetch recent transactions from a test wallet
    # You can override this with specific signatures or wallets
    command: ["--wallet", "HhxRJzEbnqgFs9FLzqSeDL8Dx2a1ubhyY82SMvKRZ3Vr", "--count", "3"]
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 128M
          cpus: '0.10'

  # NORMALIZER-SERVICE-DEPTH-BUILDER - Pool Depth Calculation
  # =========================================================
  # This service calculates and stores pool depths
  # for efficient price and liquidity lookups.
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Redis being healthy.
  # It will not start until Redis is ready to accept connections.
  normalizer-service-depth-builder:
    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: crates/normalizer-service/Dockerfile
    image: normalizer-service-depth-builder:latest
    container_name: normalizer-service-depth-builder
    environment:
      # Redis connection string
      - REDIS_URL=${REDIS_URL:-redis://redis:6379/0}
      # Logging configuration
      - RUST_LOG=${RUST_LOG:-info}
      # Starting ID for depth calculation
      - START_ID=${DEPTH_START_ID:-0}
    entrypoint: ["/usr/local/bin/depth-builder"]
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped

  # SHYFT-POOL-DEPTH SERVICE - Shyft Pool Depth Updates
  # ===================================================
  # This service periodically updates the Shyft pool depth cache
  # based on the latest data from the Solana blockchain.
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Redis being healthy.
  # It will not start until Redis is ready to accept connections.
  shyft-pool-depth:
    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: crates/shyft-pool-depth/Dockerfile
    image: shyft-pool-depth:latest
    container_name: shyft-pool-depth
    environment:
      # Redis connection string
      - REDIS_URL=${REDIS_URL:-redis://redis:6379/0}
      # Shyft API key for authentication
      - SHYFT_API_KEY=${SHYFT_API_KEY}
      # Logging configuration
      - RUST_LOG=${RUST_LOG:-info}
      # Update interval for Shyft cache
      - UPDATE_INTERVAL=${SHYFT_UPDATE_INTERVAL:-30}
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy

  # =============================================================================
  # STREAMING SERVICES - Solana DEX Data Streaming
  # =============================================================================

  # STREAM-ORCA SERVICE - Solana DEX Data Streamer (Orca)
  # ======================================================
  # This service streams Solana DEX data (Orca) from the blockchain
  # and publishes it to Kafka for real-time processing.
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Redis and Kafka being healthy.
  # It will not start until both are ready.
  stream-orca:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: stream-orca/Dockerfile
      target: runtime
      args:
        BUILDKIT_INLINE_CACHE: 1
    image: arbitrage-stream-orca:latest
    container_name: stream-orca
    env_file:
      - .env
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      # Redis connection string
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379
      # Shyft RPC endpoint and token for data fetching
      - SHYFT_GRPC_ENDPOINT=${SHYFT_GRPC_ENDPOINT}
      - SHYFT_GRPC_TOKEN=${SHYFT_GRPC_TOKEN}
      # Logging configuration
      - LOG_LEVEL=${LOG_LEVEL:-info}
      # Metrics port for monitoring
      - METRICS_PORT=9090
      # Path to IDL files
      - IDL_PATH=/app
      # Logging configuration
      - RUST_LOG=${RUST_LOG:-info}
      # Heartbeat interval for connection monitoring
      - HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL=30
      # Connection timeout for RPC calls
      - CONNECTION_TIMEOUT=30
      # Reconnection delay
      - RECONNECT_DELAY=5
      # Enable timer for periodic updates
      - ENABLE_TIMER=${ENABLE_TIMER:-false}
      # Timer duration for periodic updates
      - TIMER_DURATION_SECONDS=${TIMER_DURATION_SECONDS:-20}
      # Program IDs to monitor
      - PROGRAM_IDS=${PROGRAM_IDS:-whirLbMiicVdio4qvUfM5KAg6Ct8VwpYzGff3uctyCc}
    ports:
      # Metrics port for monitoring
      - "9094:9090"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      # Check if stream-orca process is running
      test: ["CMD", "pgrep", "-f", "stream-orca"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 15s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1G
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'

  # STREAM-RAYDIUM SERVICE - Solana DEX Data Streamer (Raydium)
  # ==========================================================
  # This service streams Solana DEX data (Raydium) from the blockchain
  # and publishes it to Kafka for real-time processing.
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Redis and Kafka being healthy.
  # It will not start until both are ready.
  stream-raydium:
    build:
      context: ../stream-raydium
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      target: runtime
      args:
        BUILDKIT_INLINE_CACHE: 1
    image: arbitrage-stream-raydium:latest
    container_name: stream-raydium
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      # Redis connection string
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379
      # Shyft RPC endpoint and token for data fetching
      - SHYFT_GRPC_ENDPOINT=${SHYFT_GRPC_ENDPOINT}
      - SHYFT_GRPC_TOKEN=${SHYFT_GRPC_TOKEN}
      # Logging configuration
      - LOG_LEVEL=${LOG_LEVEL:-info}
      # Metrics port for monitoring
      - METRICS_PORT=9090
      # Path to IDL files
      - IDL_PATH=/app
      # Logging configuration
      - RUST_LOG=${RUST_LOG:-info}
      # Heartbeat interval for connection monitoring
      - HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL=30
      # Connection timeout for RPC calls
      - CONNECTION_TIMEOUT=30
      # Reconnection delay
      - RECONNECT_DELAY=5
    ports:
      # Metrics port for monitoring
      - "9093:9090"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      # Check if stream-raydium process is running
      test: ["CMD", "pgrep", "-f", "stream-raydium"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 15s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1G
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'

  # =============================================================================
  # PROCESSING SERVICES - Data Processing and Aggregation
  # =============================================================================

  # SWAP-INGEST SERVICE - Solana DEX Swap Data Ingestion
  # =====================================================
  # This service consumes raw Solana DEX swap data from Kafka,
  # validates it, and stores it in Redis for quick retrieval.
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Redis and Kafka being healthy.
  # It will not start until both are ready.
  swap-ingest:
    build:
      context: ../Arbitrage/solana-arbitrage/swap-ingest
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      target: runtime
      args:
        BUILDKIT_INLINE_CACHE: 1
    image: arbitrage-swap-ingest:latest
    container_name: swap-ingest
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
      stream-orca:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      # Redis connection string
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379
      # Logging configuration
      - LOG_LEVEL=${LOG_LEVEL:-info}
      # Minimum profit threshold for alerts
      - MIN_PROFIT_THRESHOLD=${MIN_PROFIT_THRESHOLD:-1.001}
      # Metrics port for monitoring
      - METRICS_PORT=9090
      # Logging configuration
      - RUST_LOG=${RUST_LOG:-info}
      # Heartbeat interval for connection monitoring
      - HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL=30
      # Batch size for processing
      - BATCH_SIZE=50
      # Processing timeout
      - PROCESSING_TIMEOUT=30
    ports:
      # Metrics port for monitoring
      - "9094:9090"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      # Check if swap-ingest process is running
      test: ["CMD", "pgrep", "-f", "swap-ingest"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 15s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1G
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'

  # DATA-STREAM-PROCESSOR SERVICE - Data Stream Processing
  # =====================================================
  # This service continuously processes data streams from Kafka,
  # performs various aggregations, and updates the database.
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Redis and Kafka being healthy.
  # It will not start until both are ready.
  data-stream-processor:
    build:
      context: ../data-stream-processor
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      args:
        BUILDKIT_INLINE_CACHE: 1
    image: data-stream-processor:latest
    container_name: data-stream-processor
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      # Redis connection string
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379
      # Processing interval for data streams
      - PROCESSING_INTERVAL=5
      # Logging configuration
      - RUST_LOG=${RUST_LOG:-info}
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      # Check if data-stream-processor process is running
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "ps aux | grep data-stream-processor | grep -v grep || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 15s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 128M
          cpus: '0.1'

  # PATHFINDER SERVICE - Pathfinding and Arbitrage Calculation
  # =========================================================
  # This service uses the swap data to find profitable trading
  # opportunities and generate potential arbitrage paths.
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Swap-Ingest and Data-Stream-Processor
  # being healthy. It will not start until both are ready.
  pathfinder:
    build:
      context: ../Arbitrage/solana-arbitrage/pathfinder
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      target: runtime
      args:
        BUILDKIT_INLINE_CACHE: 1
    image: arbitrage-pathfinder:latest
    container_name: pathfinder
    depends_on:
      swap-ingest:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      # Logging configuration
      - LOG_LEVEL=${LOG_LEVEL:-info}
      # Minimum profit threshold for arbitrage
      - MIN_PROFIT_THRESHOLD=${MIN_PROFIT_THRESHOLD:-1.001}
      # Maximum path length for exploration
      - MAX_PATH_LENGTH=${MAX_PATH_LENGTH:-5}
      # Scan interval for new opportunities
      - SCAN_INTERVAL_SECONDS=${SCAN_INTERVAL_SECONDS:-1}
      # Metrics port for monitoring
      - METRICS_PORT=9090
      # Logging configuration
      - RUST_LOG=${RUST_LOG:-info}
      # Heartbeat interval for connection monitoring
      - HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL=30
      # Maximum concurrent paths to explore
      - MAX_CONCURRENT_PATHS=100
      # Path cache TTL
      - PATH_CACHE_TTL=300
    ports:
      # Metrics port for monitoring
      - "9095:9090"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      # Check if pathfinder process is running
      test: ["CMD", "pgrep", "-f", "pathfinder"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 15s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1G
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'

  # =============================================================================
  # MONITORING & DEBUGGING - Monitoring and Debugging Tools
  # =============================================================================

  # REDIS-VIEWER SERVICE - Redis Data Browser
  # ==========================================
  # This service provides a web-based interface to browse and
  # interact with Redis data, including key-value pairs and
  # memory usage statistics.
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Redis being healthy.
  # It will not start until Redis is ready.
  redis-viewer:
    build:
      context: ../Arbitrage/solana-arbitrage/redis-viewer
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      args:
        BUILDKIT_INLINE_CACHE: 1
    image: arbitrage-redis-viewer:latest
    container_name: redis-viewer
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      # Redis connection string
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379
      # Port for the web interface
      - PORT=5001
      # Refresh interval for data updates
      - REFRESH_INTERVAL=5
    ports:
      # Web interface accessible at http://localhost:5001
      - "5001:5001"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      # Test web interface availability
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--no-verbose", "--tries=1", "--spider", "http://localhost:5001/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 128M
          cpus: '0.1'

  # Prometheus for metrics collection
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:latest
    container_name: prometheus
    ports:
      # Prometheus metrics endpoint
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      # Prometheus configuration file
      - ./prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml
      # Persistent storage for metrics data
      - prometheus_data:/prometheus
    command:
      # Start Prometheus with the specified configuration
      - '--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml'
      # Set the data retention time for metrics
      - '--storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus'
      # Enable lifecycle management for Prometheus
      - '--web.enable-lifecycle'
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      # Test Prometheus availability
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--no-verbose", "--tries=1", "--spider", "http://localhost:9090/-/healthy"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'

  # Grafana for metrics visualization
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:latest
    container_name: grafana
    ports:
      # Grafana web interface
      - "3000:3000"
    environment:
      # Basic Grafana admin password
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD=admin123
      # Disable user sign-up for security
      - GF_USERS_ALLOW_SIGN_UP=false
    volumes:
      # Persistent storage for Grafana data
      - grafana_data:/var/lib/grafana
      # Provision Grafana dashboards
      - ./grafana/dashboards:/etc/grafana/provisioning/dashboards
      # Provision Grafana data sources
      - ./grafana/datasources:/etc/grafana/provisioning/datasources
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      prometheus:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      # Test Grafana availability
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--no-verbose", "--tries=1", "--spider", "http://localhost:3000/api/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'

  # =============================================================================
  # DATABASE SERVICES - Data Storage and Management
  # =============================================================================

  # POSTGRES SERVICE - Relational Database
  # ======================================
  # This service provides a PostgreSQL database for:
  # - Storing application data (e.g., user sessions, configurations)
  # - Managing application state and metadata
  # - Supporting complex queries and joins
  # - Serving as a primary data source for the application
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service is the foundation for all application data.
  # It must be available for the application to function.
  postgres:
    image: postgres:15
    container_name: postgres
    environment:
      # PostgreSQL user for application data
      - POSTGRES_USER=${POSTGRES_USER:-mev}
      # PostgreSQL password for application data
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-mevpassword}
      # PostgreSQL database name for application data
      - POSTGRES_DB=${POSTGRES_DB:-mevdb}
      # Initialize database with UTF-8 encoding and C locale
      - POSTGRES_INITDB_ARGS=--encoding=UTF8 --lc-collate=C --lc-ctype=C
    ports:
      # PostgreSQL port for external connections (mapped to 5433 to avoid local PostgreSQL conflict)
      - "5433:5432"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    volumes:
      # Persistent storage for PostgreSQL data
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      # Migration scripts for database initialization
      - ./migrations:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      # Test PostgreSQL availability
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U ${POSTGRES_USER:-mev} -d ${POSTGRES_DB:-mevdb}"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 10s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1G
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.25'

  # ADMINER SERVICE - Database Management Tool
  # ========================================
  # This service provides a web-based interface for:
  # - Managing PostgreSQL databases and users
  # - Executing SQL queries
  # - Monitoring database performance
  # - Backing up and restoring data
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on PostgreSQL being healthy.
  # It will not start until PostgreSQL is ready.
  adminer:
    image: adminer
    container_name: adminer
    ports:
      # Adminer web interface
      - "8082:8080"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      # Test Adminer availability
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--no-verbose", "--tries=1", "--spider", "http://localhost:8080/"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 128M
          cpus: '0.1'

  # =============================================================================
  # DEVELOPMENT SERVICES (Optional) - Development and Testing
  # =============================================================================

  # Development service with hot reloading for stream-orca
  stream-orca-dev:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: stream-orca/Dockerfile.dev
    environment:
      # Shyft RPC endpoint and token for development
      - SHYFT_GRPC_ENDPOINT=${SHYFT_GRPC_ENDPOINT}
      - SHYFT_GRPC_TOKEN=${SHYFT_GRPC_TOKEN}
      # Redis connection string for development
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379
      # Logging configuration for development
      - RUST_LOG=${RUST_LOG:-debug}
      # Heartbeat interval for development
      - HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL=30
    volumes:
      # Mount source directory for hot-reloading
      - ../stream-orca:/app
      # Cache for cargo dependencies
      - cargo_cache:/usr/local/cargo/registry
      # Cache for build artifacts
      - target_cache:/app/target
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      # Check if cargo-watch process is running for hot-reloading
      test: ["CMD", "pgrep", "-f", "cargo-watch"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 20s
    profiles:
      - dev
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1G
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'

  # =============================================================================
  # CACHE LAYERS (for faster rebuilds) - Persistent Storage
  # =============================================================================

  # Stream-orca cache layer
  stream-orca-cache:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: stream-orca/Dockerfile
      target: builder
    image: arbitrage-stream-orca:cache
    profiles:
      - cache

  # Stream-raydium cache layer
  stream-raydium-cache:
    build:
      context: ../stream-raydium
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      target: builder
    image: arbitrage-stream-raydium:cache
    profiles:
      - cache

  # Price-aggregator SERVICE - Price Data Aggregation
  # ================================================
  # This service consumes normalized swap data from Kafka,
  # performs price calculations, and publishes them to a topic.
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Kafka and Redis being healthy.
  # It will not start until both are ready.
  price-aggregator:
    build:
      context: ../../crates/price-aggregator
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    image: price-aggregator:latest
    container_name: price-aggregator
    environment:
      # Kafka broker connection
      - KAFKA_BROKER=kafka:9092
      # Input topic for normalized swap data
      - IN_TOPIC=${AGG_IN_TOPIC:-orca-swaps.parsed.v2}
      # Output topic for aggregated prices
      - OUT_TOPIC=${AGG_OUT_TOPIC:-prices.latest}
      # Consumer group ID for price aggregation
      - GROUP_ID=${AGG_GROUP_ID:-price-aggregator}
      # Emit interval for price updates
      - EMIT_SECS=${AGG_EMIT_SECS:-5}
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ARB-TEST-MODE SERVICE - Arbitrage Testing Mode
  # ===============================================
  # This service allows for testing arbitrage strategies
  # without deploying the full trading platform.
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Kafka and Redis being healthy.
  # It will not start until both are ready.
  arb-test-mode:
    build:
      context: ../../crates/arb-test-mode
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    image: arb-test-mode:latest
    container_name: arb-test-mode
    environment:
      # Kafka broker connection
      - KAFKA_BROKER=kafka:9092
      # Input topic for normalized swap data
      - IN_TOPIC=${ARB_IN_TOPIC:-orca-swaps.parsed.v2}
      # Redis connection string
      - REDIS_URL=${REDIS_URL:-redis://redis:6379/0}
      # Logging configuration
      - RUST_LOG=${RUST_LOG:-info}
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped

  # UI-GATEWAY SERVICE - Frontend Gateway
  # =====================================
  # This service acts as a reverse proxy and gateway for
  # the application's frontend, handling API requests
  # and routing them to the appropriate backend services.
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Kafka and Redis being healthy.
  # It will not start until both are ready.
  ui-gateway:
    build:
      context: ../../crates/ui-gateway
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    image: ui-gateway:latest
    container_name: ui-gateway
    environment:
      # Kafka broker connection
      - KAFKA_BROKER=kafka:9092
      # Topics for data consumption
      - PRICES_TOPIC=${PRICES_TOPIC:-prices.latest}
      - SWAPS_TOPIC=${SWAPS_TOPIC:-orca-swaps.parsed}
      - SWAPS_V2_TOPIC=${SWAPS_V2_TOPIC:-orca-swaps.parsed.v2}
      # Redis connection string
      - REDIS_URL=${REDIS_URL:-redis://redis:6379/0}
      # Logging configuration
      - RUST_LOG=${RUST_LOG:-info}
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped

  # DISCOVERY-SERVICE - AI Program ID Discovery
  # ==========================================
  # This service uses Kafka to discover new Solana program IDs
  # that are not yet registered in the Shyft system.
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Kafka and Redis being healthy.
  # It will not start until both are ready.
  discovery-service:
    build:
      context: ../../crates/discovery-service
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    image: discovery-service:latest
    container_name: discovery-service
    environment:
      # Kafka broker connection
      - KAFKA_BROKER=kafka:9092
      # Redis connection string
      - REDIS_URL=${REDIS_URL:-redis://redis:6379/0}
      # Topic for unknown program IDs
      - UNKNOWN_PROGRAMS_TOPIC=${UNKNOWN_PROGRAMS_TOPIC:-unknown-programs}
      # Logging configuration
      - RUST_LOG=${RUST_LOG:-info}
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - kafka
      - redis

  # SHYFT-VALIDATOR - Enhanced Shyft API Integration Service
  # ======================================================
  # This service watches for Orca/Raydium swap transactions and calls Shyft APIs
  # with a sliding window approach for API readiness.
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Kafka being healthy.
  # It will not start until Kafka is ready.
  #
  # INPUT: orca-swaps.parsed.v2 topic (parsed swap transactions)
  # OUTPUT: shyft-swaps-parsed topic (enriched data with Shyft API results)
  # FEATURES: Sliding window delay for API readiness, DEX program detection
  shyft-validator:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: crates/shyft-validator/Dockerfile
    container_name: shyft-validator
    depends_on:
      kafka:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      # Core service configuration
      - RUST_LOG=info
      # Shyft API configuration
      - SHYFT_API_KEY=${SHYFT_API_KEY}
      - SHYFT_NETWORK=mainnet-beta
      # Kafka broker connection
      - KAFKA_BROKER=kafka:9092
      # Health check configuration
      - HEALTH_PORT=8086
      - BIND_ADDRESS=0.0.0.0
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'

  # SHYFT-RAW-PRICE-FEED - Live price feed from Shyft RAW transactions
  # ================================================================
  # Consumes only live RAW transaction data and emits normalized price updates
  shyft-raw-price-feed:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: crates/shyft-raw-price-feed/Dockerfile
    container_name: shyft-raw-price-feed
    depends_on:
      kafka:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      - RUST_LOG=info
      - KAFKA_BROKER=kafka:9092
      - INPUT_TOPIC=shyft-full-transactions-raw
      - OUTPUT_TOPIC=prices.latest.raw
      - GROUP_ID=shyft-raw-price-feed
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 128M
          cpus: '0.10'

  # =============================================================================
  # PARSER SERVICES - Individual DEX Parser Microservices  
  # =============================================================================
  
  # Jupiter Parser Service - Isolated Jupiter V6 Transaction Processing
  jupiter-parser-service:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: crates/jupiter-parser-service/Dockerfile
    container_name: jupiter-parser-service
    profiles: ["parsers", "jupiter"]
    environment:
      - RUST_LOG=${RUST_LOG:-info}
      - SERVICE_PORT=8086
      - BIND_ADDRESS=0.0.0.0
      - KAFKA_BROKERS=kafka:9092
      - KAFKA_TOPIC=dex-transactions
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379
    ports:
      - "8086:8086"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    depends_on:
      kafka:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:8086/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 40s
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "traefik.enable=true"
      - "traefik.http.routers.jupiter-parser.rule=Host(`jupiter-parser.local`)"
      - "traefik.http.services.jupiter-parser.loadbalancer.server.port=8086"

networks:
  mevana_net:
    external: true
    name: mevana_net

volumes:
  postgres_data:
    driver: local
  prometheus_data:
    driver: local
  grafana_data:
    driver: local
  cargo_cache:
    driver: local
  target_cache:
    driver: local

```

Let me start the Jupiter parser locally again to be sure it's running, then I'll sample the jupiter.parsed topic for up to 15 seconds to capture enriched messages.

- Jupiter TX stream is up; parser is running locally, but the consumer timed out reading `jupiter.parsed`. Likely no Jupiter instructions arrived in that window. Two options:
  - Wait/extend sampling and try again, or
  - Temporarily widen `jupiter-tx-stream` to include both JUP and Whirlpool to increase throughput, or switch parser to read from a longer-lived topic partition/earliest.

Pick one:
- Extend consume window to 60s and print any enriched messages.
- Widen filters briefly to increase message volume.
- I can also add a tiny debug that logs each produced record count so we know parser is producing.

```rust
//! Jupiter Parser Service
//!
//! Isolated microservice for parsing Jupiter V6 aggregator transactions
//! Processes ONLY Jupiter transactions with complete independence

use anyhow::Result;
use axum::{extract::State, response::Json, routing::get, Router};
use clap::Parser;
use prost::Message as ProstMessage;
use rdkafka::config::ClientConfig;
use rdkafka::consumer::{Consumer, StreamConsumer};
use rdkafka::message::Message;
use rdkafka::producer::{FutureProducer, FutureRecord};
use serde::Serialize;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};
use tokio::sync::RwLock;
use tracing::{debug, error, info, warn};
// Generated decoders (curated from IDLs)
use normalizer_generated as generated;

// Jupiter program IDs we support
const JUPITER_AGGREGATOR_V4: &str = "JUP4Fb2cqiRUcaTHdrPC8h2gNsA2ETXiPDD33WcGuJB";
const JUPITER_AGGREGATOR_V6: &str = "JUP6LkbZbjS1jKKwapdHNy74zcZ3tLUZoi5QNyVTaV4";
const JUPITER_LIMIT_V1: &str = "jupoNjAxXgZ4rjzxzPMP4oxduvQsQtZzyknqvzYNrNu";
const JUPITER_LIMIT_V2: &str = "j1o2qRpjcyUwEvwtcfhEQefh773ZgjxcVRry7LDqg5X";

#[derive(Parser)]
#[command(name = "jupiter-parser-service", version = "0.1.0")]
struct Args {
    #[arg(long, env = "KAFKA_BROKERS", default_value = "localhost:29092")]
    kafka_brokers: String,

    #[arg(long, env = "KAFKA_TOPIC", default_value = "dex-transactions")]
    kafka_topic: String,

    #[arg(long, env = "REDIS_URL", default_value = "redis://localhost:6379")]
    redis_url: String,

    #[arg(long, env = "SERVICE_PORT", default_value = "8086")]
    service_port: u16,

    #[arg(long, env = "BIND_ADDRESS", default_value = "0.0.0.0")]
    bind_address: String,

    #[arg(long, env = "JUPITER_OUT_TOPIC", default_value = "jupiter.parsed")]
    out_topic_combined: String,

    #[arg(
        long,
        env = "JUPITER_OUT_SWAP_TOPIC",
        default_value = "jupiter.swap.parsed"
    )]
    out_topic_swap: String,

    #[arg(
        long,
        env = "JUPITER_OUT_LIMIT_TOPIC",
        default_value = "jupiter.limit.parsed"
    )]
    out_topic_limit: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize)]
struct JupiterStats {
    total_transactions: u64,
    jupiter_transactions: u64,
    successful_parses: u64,
    failed_parses: u64,
    produced_messages: u64,
    instruction_types: HashMap<String, u64>,
    last_transaction_time: Option<std::time::SystemTime>,
    average_latency_ms: f64,
}

#[derive(Clone)]
struct AppState {
    stats: Arc<RwLock<JupiterStats>>,
    redis_client: redis::Client,
}

#[derive(Serialize)]
struct HealthResponse {
    status: String,
    service: String,
    program_ids: Vec<String>,
    uptime_seconds: u64,
    stats: JupiterStats,
}

#[derive(Serialize)]
struct MetricsResponse {
    jupiter_transactions_total: u64,
    jupiter_successful_parses_total: u64,
    jupiter_failed_parses_total: u64,
    jupiter_produced_messages_total: u64,
    jupiter_parse_latency_ms: f64,
    jupiter_instruction_types: HashMap<String, u64>,
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
    // Initialize environment and logging
    dotenv::dotenv().ok();
    tracing_subscriber::fmt::init();

    let args = Args::parse();

    info!("🚀 Starting Jupiter Parser Service");
    info!(
        "Target Program IDs: {}, {}, {}, {}",
        JUPITER_AGGREGATOR_V4, JUPITER_AGGREGATOR_V6, JUPITER_LIMIT_V1, JUPITER_LIMIT_V2
    );
    info!("Kafka: {} -> {}", args.kafka_brokers, args.kafka_topic);
    info!("Service Port: {}", args.service_port);

    // Initialize Redis connection
    let redis_client = redis::Client::open(args.redis_url.as_str())?;

    // Test Redis connection
    {
        let mut conn = redis_client.get_multiplexed_tokio_connection().await?;
        let _: String = redis::cmd("PING").query_async(&mut conn).await?;
        info!("✅ Redis connection verified");
    }

    // Initialize shared state
    let app_state = AppState {
        stats: Arc::new(RwLock::new(JupiterStats::default())),
        redis_client,
    };

    // Start health/metrics server
    let health_server = start_health_server(
        app_state.clone(),
        args.bind_address.clone(),
        args.service_port,
    );

    // Start Jupiter transaction processor
    let processor = start_jupiter_processor(
        app_state.clone(),
        args.kafka_brokers.clone(),
        args.kafka_topic.clone(),
        args.out_topic_combined.clone(),
        args.out_topic_swap.clone(),
        args.out_topic_limit.clone(),
    );

    // Run both tasks concurrently
    tokio::select! {
        result = health_server => {
            error!("Health server failed: {:?}", result);
        }
        result = processor => {
            error!("Jupiter processor failed: {:?}", result);
        }
    }

    Ok(())
}

async fn start_health_server(state: AppState, bind_address: String, port: u16) -> Result<()> {
    let app = Router::new()
        .route("/health", get(health_handler))
        .route("/metrics", get(metrics_handler))
        .with_state(state);

    let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind(format!("{}:{}", bind_address, port)).await?;
    info!("🏥 Health server listening on {}:{}", bind_address, port);

    axum::serve(listener, app).await?;
    Ok(())
}

async fn health_handler(State(state): State<AppState>) -> Json<HealthResponse> {
    let stats = state.stats.read().await.clone();

    Json(HealthResponse {
        status: "healthy".to_string(),
        service: "jupiter-parser-service".to_string(),
        program_ids: vec![
            JUPITER_AGGREGATOR_V4.to_string(),
            JUPITER_AGGREGATOR_V6.to_string(),
            JUPITER_LIMIT_V1.to_string(),
            JUPITER_LIMIT_V2.to_string(),
        ],
        uptime_seconds: 0, // TODO: Track actual uptime
        stats,
    })
}

async fn metrics_handler(State(state): State<AppState>) -> Json<MetricsResponse> {
    let stats = state.stats.read().await;

    Json(MetricsResponse {
        jupiter_transactions_total: stats.jupiter_transactions,
        jupiter_successful_parses_total: stats.successful_parses,
        jupiter_failed_parses_total: stats.failed_parses,
        jupiter_produced_messages_total: stats.produced_messages,
        jupiter_parse_latency_ms: stats.average_latency_ms,
        jupiter_instruction_types: stats.instruction_types.clone(),
    })
}

async fn start_jupiter_processor(
    state: AppState,
    kafka_brokers: String,
    kafka_topic: String,
    out_topic_combined: String,
    out_topic_swap: String,
    out_topic_limit: String,
) -> Result<()> {
    // Create Kafka consumer
    let consumer: StreamConsumer = ClientConfig::new()
        .set("bootstrap.servers", &kafka_brokers)
        .set("group.id", "jupiter-parser-service")
        .set("enable.auto.commit", "true")
        .set("auto.offset.reset", "latest")
        .create()?;

    consumer.subscribe(&[&kafka_topic])?;
    info!("✅ Connected to Kafka topic: {}", kafka_topic);

    // Create Kafka producer
    let producer: FutureProducer = ClientConfig::new()
        .set("bootstrap.servers", &kafka_brokers)
        .create()?;

    // Periodic heartbeat for operator feedback
    {
        let stats_ref = state.stats.clone();
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            let mut interval = tokio::time::interval(Duration::from_secs(30));
            loop {
                interval.tick().await;
                let snapshot = stats_ref.read().await.clone();
                let last_age = snapshot
                    .last_transaction_time
                    .and_then(|t| t.elapsed().ok())
                    .map(|d| format!("{}s ago", d.as_secs()))
                    .unwrap_or_else(|| "never".to_string());
                info!(
                    "📈 Jupiter parser heartbeat: total={}, jupiter={}, produced={}, avg_ms={:.2}, last_seen={}",
                    snapshot.total_transactions,
                    snapshot.jupiter_transactions,
                    snapshot.produced_messages,
                    snapshot.average_latency_ms,
                    last_age
                );
            }
        });
    }

    loop {
        match consumer.recv().await {
            Ok(message) => {
                if let Some(payload) = message.payload() {
                    let mut stats = state.stats.write().await;
                    stats.total_transactions += 1;

                    if let Err(e) = process_transaction(
                        payload,
                        &mut stats,
                        &state.redis_client,
                        &producer,
                        &out_topic_combined,
                        &out_topic_swap,
                        &out_topic_limit,
                    )
                    .await
                    {
                        warn!("Failed to process transaction: {}", e);
                        stats.failed_parses += 1;
                    }
                }
            }
            Err(e) => {
                error!("Kafka error: {}", e);
                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_secs(1)).await;
            }
        }
    }
}

async fn process_transaction(
    payload: &[u8],
    stats: &mut JupiterStats,
    redis_client: &redis::Client,
    producer: &FutureProducer,
    out_topic_combined: &str,
    out_topic_swap: &str,
    out_topic_limit: &str,
) -> Result<()> {
    let parse_start = Instant::now();

    // Decode yellowstone transaction
    let transaction_data =
        yellowstone_grpc_proto::prelude::SubscribeUpdateTransaction::decode(payload)?;

    let Some(info) = transaction_data.transaction.as_ref() else {
        return Ok(());
    };

    let Some(transaction) = info.transaction.as_ref() else {
        return Ok(());
    };

    let Some(message) = transaction.message.as_ref() else {
        return Ok(());
    };

    // Build account keys
    let account_keys: Vec<String> = message
        .account_keys
        .iter()
        .map(|key| bs58::encode(key).into_string())
        .collect();

    // Capture signature once for enrichment
    let signature = if let Some(info) = transaction_data.transaction.as_ref() {
        bs58::encode(&info.signature).into_string()
    } else {
        String::new()
    };

    // Process each instruction - look for Jupiter
    for (ix_index, instruction) in message.instructions.iter().enumerate() {
        let program_id_index = instruction.program_id_index as usize;

        if let Some(program_id) = account_keys.get(program_id_index) {
            // Process only Jupiter program IDs
            let is_jupiter = matches!(
                program_id.as_str(),
                JUPITER_AGGREGATOR_V4 | JUPITER_AGGREGATOR_V6 | JUPITER_LIMIT_V1 | JUPITER_LIMIT_V2
            );
            if !is_jupiter {
                continue;
            }

            stats.jupiter_transactions += 1;

            // Try curated decoder; fallback to unknown
            let mut instruction_name = "unknown".to_string();
            let mut roles: HashMap<String, String> = HashMap::new();
            if let Some(decoder) = generated::decoder_for(program_id) {
                if let Some((name, decoded_roles)) =
                    decoder(&instruction.data, &instruction.accounts, &account_keys)
                {
                    instruction_name = name;
                    roles = decoded_roles;
                }
            }

            let parse_time = parse_start.elapsed();

            // Update stats
            stats.successful_parses += 1;
            *stats
                .instruction_types
                .entry(instruction_name.clone())
                .or_insert(0) += 1;
            stats.average_latency_ms = parse_time.as_secs_f64() * 1000.0;
            stats.last_transaction_time = Some(std::time::SystemTime::now());

            // Store to Redis
            if let Err(e) = store_jupiter_transaction(
                redis_client,
                &transaction_data,
                ix_index,
                &instruction_name,
                &roles,
                program_id,
            )
            .await
            {
                warn!("Failed to store to Redis: {}", e);
            }

            // Prepare instruction accounts summary
            let ix_accounts: Vec<serde_json::Value> = instruction
                .accounts
                .iter()
                .map(|i| *i as usize)
                .filter_map(|idx| account_keys.get(idx).cloned().map(|k| (idx, k)))
                .map(|(idx, key)| serde_json::json!({ "index": idx, "key": key }))
                .collect();

            // Produce to Kafka topics (enriched)
            let payload_json = serde_json::json!({
                "slot": transaction_data.slot,
                "signature": signature,
                "ix_index": ix_index,
                "instruction_name": instruction_name,
                "program_id": program_id,
                "roles": roles,
                "accounts": ix_accounts,
            })
            .to_string();

            let result_combined = producer
                .send(
                    FutureRecord::<(), _>::to(out_topic_combined).payload(&payload_json),
                    Duration::from_secs(5),
                )
                .await;

            let topic = if matches!(program_id.as_str(), JUPITER_LIMIT_V1 | JUPITER_LIMIT_V2) {
                out_topic_limit
            } else {
                out_topic_swap
            };

            let result_specific = producer
                .send(
                    FutureRecord::<(), _>::to(topic).payload(&payload_json),
                    Duration::from_secs(5),
                )
                .await;

            // Count only successful deliveries
            if result_combined.is_ok() { stats.produced_messages += 1; }
            if result_specific.is_ok() { stats.produced_messages += 1; }
        }
    }

    Ok(())
}

async fn store_jupiter_transaction(
    redis_client: &redis::Client,
    transaction_data: &yellowstone_grpc_proto::prelude::SubscribeUpdateTransaction,
    ix_index: usize,
    instruction_name: &str,
    roles: &HashMap<String, String>,
    program_id: &str,
) -> Result<()> {
    let mut conn = redis_client.get_multiplexed_tokio_connection().await?;

    let signature = if let Some(info) = transaction_data.transaction.as_ref() {
        bs58::encode(&info.signature).into_string()
    } else {
        return Ok(());
    };

    let jupiter_key = format!("jupiter:transaction:{}", signature);

    // Store Jupiter transaction data
    let jupiter_data = serde_json::json!({
        "signature": signature,
        "slot": transaction_data.slot,
        "ix_index": ix_index,
        "instruction_name": instruction_name,
        "program_id": program_id,
        "roles": roles,
        "parsed_at": chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
        "parser_service": "jupiter-parser-service"
    });

    let _: () = redis::cmd("HSET")
        .arg(&jupiter_key)
        .arg("data")
        .arg(jupiter_data.to_string())
        .query_async(&mut conn)
        .await?;

    // Set expiration (24 hours)
    let _: () = redis::cmd("EXPIRE")
        .arg(&jupiter_key)
        .arg(86400)
        .query_async(&mut conn)
        .await?;

    debug!("💾 Stored Jupiter transaction: {}", signature);

    Ok(())
}
```

```dockerfile
FROM rust:1.88-slim as builder

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    pkg-config \
    libssl-dev \
    build-essential \
    cmake \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

WORKDIR /usr/src/app

# Copy just what we need
COPY crates/normalizer-generated /usr/src/app/crates/normalizer-generated
COPY crates/normalizer-runtime /usr/src/app/crates/normalizer-runtime
COPY crates/jupiter-parser-service /usr/src/app/crates/jupiter-parser-service

# Build
RUN cargo build --release --manifest-path crates/jupiter-parser-service/Cargo.toml

FROM debian:bookworm-slim
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl librdkafka1 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /usr/src/app/target/release/jupiter-parser-service /app/jupiter-parser-service
EXPOSE 8086
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=10s --start-period=40s --retries=3 CMD curl -f http://:8086/health || exit 1
CMD ["./jupiter-parser-service"]
```
