```dockercompose
# =============================================================================
# SOLANA AI TRADING PLATFORM - ENHANCED DOCKER COMPOSE
# =============================================================================
# Enhanced version with improved connectivity, monitoring, and resource management
#
# NETWORK ARCHITECTURE OVERVIEW:
# =============================
# This compose file establishes a complete infrastructure foundation for the MEVana
# trading platform. Services are deployed in dependency order with proper health
# checks to ensure reliable startup sequences.
#
# DEPLOYMENT ORDER (CRITICAL):
# 1. Zookeeper (2181) - Kafka coordination service
# 2. Kafka (9092/29092) - Message broker (depends on Zookeeper)
# 3. Kafka-UI (8080) - Management interface (depends on Kafka)
# 4. Redis (6379) - Data caching service
# 5. Redis-UI (8083) - Management interface (depends on Redis)
#
# NETWORK ISOLATION:
# - All services use 'mevana_net' external network
# - Internal communication via Docker DNS (e.g., kafka:9092)
# - External access via localhost ports for development
#
# HEALTH CHECK STRATEGY:
# - Zookeeper: Basic connectivity test
# - Kafka: Topic listing capability
# - Redis: Ping/incr operation
# - UI Services: HTTP endpoint availability
#
# RESOURCE MANAGEMENT:
# - Memory and CPU limits set for production stability
# - Log rotation configured to prevent disk space issues
# - Graceful restart policies for service recovery
# =============================================================================

services:
  # =============================================================================
  # INFRASTRUCTURE SERVICES - CORE MESSAGE BROKER STACK
  # =============================================================================
  
  # ZOOKEEPER SERVICE - Kafka Coordination Foundation
  # ================================================
  # Zookeeper is the coordination service that Kafka requires for:
  # - Leader election and failover
  # - Configuration management
  # - Distributed synchronization
  # - Service discovery
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service MUST start first and be healthy before Kafka
  # can initialize. All Kafka operations depend on Zookeeper availability.
  zookeeper:
    image: confluentinc/cp-zookeeper:7.4.0
    container_name: zookeeper
    environment:
      # Client connection port - used by Kafka and other services
      ZOOKEEPER_CLIENT_PORT: 2181
      # Heartbeat interval in milliseconds
      ZOOKEEPER_TICK_TIME: 2000
      # Autopurge settings to limit snapshot/log growth
      # Retain the last 3 snapshots; purge every 24 hours
      ZOOKEEPER_AUTOPURGE_SNAP_RETAIN_COUNT: 3
      ZOOKEEPER_AUTOPURGE_PURGE_INTERVAL: 24
      # Maximum number of client connections
      ZOOKEEPER_MAX_CLIENT_CNXNS: 60
      # Sync limit for follower synchronization
      ZOOKEEPER_SYNC_LIMIT: 2
      # Initial limit for leader election
      ZOOKEEPER_INIT_LIMIT: 5
    healthcheck:
      # Test Zookeeper connectivity by attempting a basic operation
      test: ["CMD", "bash", "-c", "echo stat | nc localhost 2181"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 10s
    ports:
      # Expose Zookeeper port for external monitoring and debugging
      - "2181:2181"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'

  # KAFKA SERVICE - Message Broker Core
  # ===================================
  # Kafka is the central message broker that handles:
  # - High-throughput message streaming
  # - Topic management and partitioning
  # - Consumer group coordination
  # - Message persistence and replication
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Zookeeper being healthy.
  # Kafka will not start until Zookeeper reports healthy status.
  # All application services depend on Kafka availability.
  kafka:
    image: confluentinc/cp-kafka:7.4.0
    container_name: kafka
    depends_on:
      zookeeper:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      # Unique broker identifier in the cluster
      KAFKA_BROKER_ID: 1
      # Zookeeper connection string for coordination
      KAFKA_ZOOKEEPER_CONNECT: zookeeper:2181
      # Network listeners configuration
      # PLAINTEXT://0.0.0.0:9092 - Internal Docker network listener
      # PLAINTEXT_HOST://0.0.0.0:29092 - External host access listener
      KAFKA_LISTENERS: PLAINTEXT://0.0.0.0:9092,PLAINTEXT_HOST://0.0.0.0:29092
      # Advertised listeners for client connections
      # PLAINTEXT://kafka:9092 - Internal Docker DNS name
      # PLAINTEXT_HOST://localhost:29092 - External localhost access
      KAFKA_ADVERTISED_LISTENERS: PLAINTEXT://kafka:9092,PLAINTEXT_HOST://localhost:29092
      # Security protocol mapping for each listener
      KAFKA_LISTENER_SECURITY_PROTOCOL_MAP: PLAINTEXT:PLAINTEXT,PLAINTEXT_HOST:PLAINTEXT
      # Internal broker communication listener
      KAFKA_INTER_BROKER_LISTENER_NAME: PLAINTEXT
      # Enable automatic topic creation for development
      KAFKA_AUTO_CREATE_TOPICS_ENABLE: "true"
      # Replication factor for system topics
      KAFKA_OFFSETS_TOPIC_REPLICATION_FACTOR: 1
      # JVM heap configuration for performance
      KAFKA_HEAP_OPTS: "-Xmx1G -Xms1G"
      # Log retention policy (7 days)
      KAFKA_LOG_RETENTION_HOURS: 168
      # Log segment size for efficient storage
      KAFKA_LOG_SEGMENT_BYTES: 1073741824
      # Default number of partitions for new topics
      KAFKA_NUM_PARTITIONS: 3
      # Default replication factor for new topics
      KAFKA_DEFAULT_REPLICATION_FACTOR: 1
      # Minimum in-sync replicas for durability
      KAFKA_MIN_INSYNC_REPLICAS: 1
      # Enable topic deletion for development flexibility
      KAFKA_DELETE_TOPIC_ENABLE: "true"
    ports:
      # Internal Docker network access
      - "9092:9092"
      # External host access for development and debugging
      - "29092:29092"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      # Test Kafka functionality by listing topics
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "kafka-topics --bootstrap-server localhost:9092 --list"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 2G
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 1G
          cpus: '0.5'

  # KAFKA-UI SERVICE - Management Interface
  # =======================================
  # Kafka-UI provides a web-based interface for:
  # - Topic management and monitoring
  # - Consumer group status
  # - Message browsing and production
  # - Cluster health monitoring
  # - Performance metrics visualization
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Kafka being healthy.
  # UI will not start until Kafka reports healthy status.
  # KAFKA-UI SERVICE - Management Interface
  # =======================================
  # Kafka-UI provides a web-based interface for:
  # - Topic browsing and management
  # - Message inspection and debugging
  # - Consumer group monitoring
  # - Cluster health and performance metrics
  # - Real-time data flow visualization
  #
  # CRITICAL CONFIGURATION REQUIREMENT:
  # ===================================
  # Kafka-UI MUST have environment variables to connect to Kafka.
  # Without these, the service will start but show no topics/data.
  # 
  # REQUIRED ENVIRONMENT VARIABLES:
  # - KAFKA_CLUSTERS_0_NAME: Cluster identifier
  # - KAFKA_CLUSTERS_0_BOOTSTRAPSERVERS: Kafka broker address (use Docker DNS)
  # - KAFKA_CLUSTERS_0_READONLY: Management permissions
  #
  # TROUBLESHOOTING: If Kafka-UI shows no topics, verify these env vars exist.
  kafka-ui:
    image: provectuslabs/kafka-ui:v0.7.2
    container_name: kafka-ui
    depends_on:
      kafka:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      # Kafka cluster configuration - REQUIRED for Kafka-UI to connect
      - KAFKA_CLUSTERS_0_NAME=local
      - KAFKA_CLUSTERS_0_BOOTSTRAPSERVERS=kafka:9092
      - KAFKA_CLUSTERS_0_READONLY=false
      # Optional: Enable topic creation and management
      - KAFKA_CLUSTERS_0_TOPICCONFIG=0
      - KAFKA_CLUSTERS_0_TOPICREPLICATION=1
    ports:
      # Web interface accessible at http://localhost:8080
      - "8080:8080"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      # Test web interface availability
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--no-verbose", "--tries=1", "--spider", "http://localhost:8080"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 128M
          cpus: '0.10'

  # REDIS SERVICE - Data Caching Foundation
  # =======================================
  # Redis provides high-performance data caching for:
  # - Token metadata and pricing information
  # - Pool state and liquidity data
  # - User session and configuration data
  # - Temporary computation results
  # - Rate limiting and throttling
  #
  # Redis operates independently of the Kafka stack and can start
  # in parallel with Zookeeper for faster overall startup.
  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: redis
    ports:
      # Redis protocol access for external clients and debugging
      - "6379:6379"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped

      # Test Redis functionality with ping and increment operation
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "--raw", "incr", "ping"]

    logging:
      driver: "json-file"

    deploy:

        reservations:

          cpus: '0.25'

  # REDIS-UI SERVICE - Management Interface

  # Redis-UI provides a web-based interface for:

  redis-ui:

      start_period: 40s
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 128M
          cpus: '0.10'

  # Production environment configuration
  dex-stream-universal-prod:
    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: crates/dex-stream-universal/Dockerfile
    profiles: ["prod"]
    container_name: dex_stream_universal_prod
    depends_on:
      kafka:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      # Core service configuration
      - RUST_LOG=warn
      - KAFKA_BROKER=kafka:9092
      - TOPIC=dex-transactions
      - ENDPOINT=https://grpc.ny.shyft.to
      - X_TOKEN=${PROD_X_TOKEN:-efff2d23-97ae-4c5f-8b8b-9a6265001189}
      - HEALTH_PORT=8084
      - BIND_ADDRESS=0.0.0.0
      - DEX_FILTERING=ON
      - PROGRAM_IDS=whirLbMiicVdio4qvUfM5KAg6Ct8VwpYzGff3uctyCc
    ports:
      - "8084:8084"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://:8084/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 40s
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 128M
          cpus: '0.10'
  # Whirlpool TX stream (reuses dex-stream-universal with Whirlpool program filter)
  # NOTE: TX-only; does NOT stream tick arrays. Safe to run alongside the universal stream.
  whirlpool-tx-stream:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: crates/dex-stream-universal/Dockerfile.slim
    container_name: whirlpool-tx-stream
    depends_on:
      kafka:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      - RUST_LOG=info
      - KAFKA_BROKER=kafka:9092
      - TOPIC=dex-transactions
      - ENDPOINT=https://grpc.ny.shyft.to
      - X_TOKEN=${X_TOKEN}
      - HEALTH_PORT=8091   # 8084 is reserved; use a free port
      - BIND_ADDRESS=0.0.0.0
      - DEX_FILTERING=ON
      # Whirlpool program ID only — keeps TX stream focused
      - PROGRAM_IDS=whirLbMiicVdio4qvUfM5KAg6Ct8VwpYzGff3uctyCc
    ports:
      - "8091:8091"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
          limits:
            memory: 256M
            cpus: '0.25'
          reservations:
            memory: 128M
            cpus: '0.10'

  # Jupiter TX stream (reuses dex-stream-universal with Jupiter program filters)
  # NOTE: TX-only; does NOT stream tick arrays. Emits raw Jupiter TXs to dex-transactions.
  jupiter-tx-stream:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: crates/dex-stream-universal/Dockerfile.slim
    container_name: jupiter-tx-stream
    depends_on:
      kafka:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      - RUST_LOG=info
      - KAFKA_BROKER=kafka:9092
      - TOPIC=dex-transactions
      - ENDPOINT=${ENDPOINT}
      - X_TOKEN=${X_TOKEN}
      - HEALTH_PORT=8092   # 8084 reserved; 8091 used by whirlpool
      - BIND_ADDRESS=0.0.0.0
      - DEX_FILTERING=ON
      # Jupiter program IDs: aggregator v4, aggregator v6, limit v1, limit v2
      - PROGRAM_IDS=JUP4Fb2cqiRUcaTHdrPC8h2gNsA2ETXiPDD33WcGuJB,JUP6LkbZbjS1jKKwapdHNy74zcZ3tLUZoi5QNyVTaV4,jupoNjAxXgZ4rjzxzPMP4oxduvQsQtZzyknqvzYNrNu,j1o2qRpjcyUwEvwtcfhEQefh773ZgjxcVRry7LDqg5X
    ports:
      - "8092:8092"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
          limits:
            memory: 256M
            cpus: '0.25'
          reservations:
            memory: 128M
            cpus: '0.10'

  # Jupiter parser service (enriched decode and re-publish)
  jupiter-parser:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: crates/jupiter-parser-service/Dockerfile.slim
    container_name: jupiter-parser
    depends_on:
      kafka:
        condition: service_healthy
      jupiter-tx-stream:
        condition: service_started
    environment:
      - RUST_LOG=info
      - KAFKA_BROKERS=kafka:9092
      - KAFKA_TOPIC=dex-transactions
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379/0
      - SERVICE_PORT=8086
      - BIND_ADDRESS=0.0.0.0
      - IDL_DIR=/app/idls
      - JUPITER_OUT_TOPIC=jupiter.parsed
      - JUPITER_OUT_SWAP_TOPIC=jupiter.swap.parsed
      - JUPITER_OUT_LIMIT_TOPIC=jupiter.limit.parsed
    ports:
      - "8086:8086"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    volumes:
      - ../idls:/app/idls:ro

  # Whirlpool state streamer (Geyser → Redis)
  whirlpool-state-streamer:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: crates/stream_and_parse_whirlpool_account_updates/Dockerfile.slim
    container_name: whirlpool-state-streamer
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      - RUST_LOG=info
      - ENDPOINT=${ENDPOINT}
      - X_TOKEN=${X_TOKEN}
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379/0
      - HEALTH_PORT=8093
      - BIND_ADDRESS=0.0.0.0
      # Optional seeding enabled to ensure initial Redis population
      - SEED_TICK_ARRAYS=1
      # - RPC_URL=https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    ports:
      - "8093:8093"
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"

  # Whirlpool quote surface: consumes Redis state → produces quotes.whirlpool.v1
  whirlpool-quote-surface:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: crates/whirlpool-quote-surface/Dockerfile.slim
    container_name: whirlpool-quote-surface
    depends_on:
      kafka:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      - RUST_LOG=info
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379/0
      - KAFKA_BROKERS=kafka:9092
      - OUT_TOPIC=quotes.whirlpool.v1
      - QUOTE_SIZES=1000000,10000000,100000000
      - QUOTE_INTERVAL_MS=1000
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
  # Jupiter Integration (publishes quotes/signals from API as a baseline comparator)
  jupiter-integration:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: crates/jupiter-integration/Dockerfile.slim
    container_name: jupiter-integration
    depends_on:
      kafka:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      - RUST_LOG=info
      - KAFKA_BROKER=kafka:9092
      - JUPITER_SIGNALS_TOPIC=quotes.jupiter.v1
      - JUPITER_API_URL=https://quote-api.jup.ag
      - JUPITER_API_KEY=${JUPITER_API_KEY}
      - JUPITER_POLL_INTERVAL_MS=1000
      - MIN_AMOUNT_THRESHOLD=1000000
      - MIN_PRICE_IMPACT_PCT=0.05
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
  # GRAPHQL-BACKFILL SERVICE - Historical data processing
  # =====================================================
  # This service fetches historical data from Shyft's GraphQL API
  # and stores it in Redis for quick retrieval.
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Redis being healthy.
  # It will not start until Redis is ready to accept connections.
  graphql-backfill:
    build:
      context: ../../crates/graphql-backfill
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    image: graphql-backfill:latest
    container_name: graphql-backfill
    environment:
      # Shyft API key for authentication
      - SHYFT_API_KEY=${SHYFT_API_KEY}
      # Shyft network (e.g., mainnet-beta, devnet)
      - SHYFT_NETWORK=${SHYFT_NETWORK:-mainnet-beta}
      # Redis connection string
      - REDIS_URL=${REDIS_URL:-redis://redis:6379/0}
      # Pagination parameters for data fetching
      - PAGE_SIZE=${PAGE_SIZE:-250}
      - MAX_PAGES=${MAX_PAGES:-200}
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: "no"
    command: ["--page-size","250","--max-pages","200"]

  # DEX-BACKFILL SERVICE - Solana DEX Data Backfill
  # ===============================================
  # This service fetches historical DEX data (swaps, positions)
  # from Solana's RPC and stores it in Redis.
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Redis being healthy.
  # It will not start until Redis is ready to accept connections.
  dex-backfill:
    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: crates/dex-backfill/Dockerfile
    image: dex-backfill:latest
    container_name: dex-backfill
    environment:
      # Shyft RPC endpoint and token for data fetching
      - ENDPOINT=${SHYFT_GRPC_ENDPOINT}
      - X_TOKEN=${SHYFT_GRPC_TOKEN}
      # Redis connection string
      - REDIS_URL=${REDIS_URL:-redis://redis:6379/0}
      # Include tick arrays and positions in backfill
      - INCLUDE_TICKARRAYS=${INCLUDE_TICKARRAYS:-true}
      - INCLUDE_POSITIONS=${INCLUDE_POSITIONS:-true}
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: ["--include-tickarrays","--include-positions"]
    volumes:
      - ../../crates/dex-backfill/idls:/app/idls
      - ../../crates/dex-backfill/scripts:/app/scripts:ro

  # NORMALIZER-SERVICE-EXTRACTOR - Data Normalization & Performance Monitoring
  # ======================================================================
  # This service consumes raw Kafka messages and normalizes
  # them into a consistent format for downstream processing.
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Kafka and Redis being healthy.
  # It will not start until both are ready.
  #
  # PERFORMANCE MONITORING:
  # - Parsing accuracy metrics
  # - Processing speed (messages/second)
  # - Error rates and types
  # - Memory and CPU usage
  # - Kafka consumer lag
  normalizer-service-extractor:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: crates/normalizer-service/Dockerfile
    container_name: normalizer-service-extractor
    depends_on:
      kafka:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      # Core service configuration
      - RUST_LOG=info
      # Kafka broker connection
      - KAFKA_BROKER=kafka:9092
      # Input topic for raw data (from dex-stream-universal)
      - IN_TOPIC=dex-transactions
      # Output topic for normalized data
      - OUT_TOPIC=orca-swaps.parsed.v2
      # Consumer group ID for message consumption
      - GROUP_ID=tap-orca-extract
      # Redis connection string
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379/0
      # Health monitoring port
      - HEALTH_PORT=8085
      - BIND_ADDRESS=0.0.0.0
      # Fast mode for quicker development
      - FAST_MODE=1
      # TTL for mint decimals cache
      - MINT_DECIMALS_TTL_MS=60000
      # TTL for pool snapshot cache
      - POOL_SNAPSHOT_TTL_MS=60000
      # Debug mode for full transaction output
      - DEBUG_MODE=1
      - DEBUG_TOPIC=normalizer-debug-full-tx
    ports:
      - "8085:8085"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://:8085/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 40s
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'

  # NORMALIZER-SERVICE-DEBUG - Full Transaction Debug Output
  # ========================================================
  # This service outputs the complete, prettified JSON of raw transactions
  # for development and analysis purposes.
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Kafka being healthy.
  # It will not start until Kafka is ready.
  #
  # OUTPUT: Full transaction JSON with all instructions, accounts, and metadata
  # LABELED: "FULL_TRANSACTION_DEBUG_OUTPUT" for easy identification
  normalizer-service-debug:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: crates/normalizer-service/Dockerfile
    container_name: normalizer-service-debug
    depends_on:
      kafka:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      # Core service configuration
      - RUST_LOG=info
      # Kafka broker connection
      - KAFKA_BROKER=kafka:9092
      # Input topic for raw data (from dex-stream-universal)
      - IN_TOPIC=dex-transactions
      # Debug topic for full transaction output
      - DEBUG_TOPIC=normalizer-debug-full-tx
      # Consumer group ID for message consumption
      - GROUP_ID=tap-orca-debug
    entrypoint: ["/usr/local/bin/tap_orca_debug"]
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 128M
          cpus: '0.10'

  # SHYFT-TRANSACTION-FETCHER - Shyft API Transaction Data
  # ======================================================
  # This service fetches decoded transactions from Shyft API and sends them to Kafka
  # for comparison with our debug output.
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Kafka being healthy.
  # It will not start until Kafka is ready.
  #
  # OUTPUT: Complete Shyft API parsed transaction data in prettified JSON
  # LABELED: "SHYFT_API_COMPLETE_TRANSACTION_PARSED" for easy identification
  shyft-transaction-fetcher:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: crates/shyft-transaction-fetcher/Dockerfile
    container_name: shyft-transaction-fetcher
    depends_on:
      kafka:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      # Core service configuration
      - RUST_LOG=info
      # Shyft API configuration
      - SHYFT_API_KEY=${SHYFT_API_KEY}
      - SHYFT_NETWORK=mainnet-beta
      # Kafka broker connection
      - KAFKA_BROKER=kafka:9092
      # Output topic for Shyft transaction data
      - OUTPUT_TOPIC=shyft-transactions-parsed
      # Health check configuration
      - HEALTH_PORT=8087
      - BIND_ADDRESS=0.0.0.0
    # Example: Fetch recent transactions from a test wallet
    # You can override this with specific signatures or wallets
    command: ["--wallet", "HhxRJzEbnqgFs9FLzqSeDL8Dx2a1ubhyY82SMvKRZ3Vr", "--count", "3"]
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 128M
          cpus: '0.10'

  # NORMALIZER-SERVICE-DEPTH-BUILDER - Pool Depth Calculation
  # =========================================================
  # This service calculates and stores pool depths
  # for efficient price and liquidity lookups.
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Redis being healthy.
  # It will not start until Redis is ready to accept connections.
  normalizer-service-depth-builder:
    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: crates/normalizer-service/Dockerfile
    image: normalizer-service-depth-builder:latest
    container_name: normalizer-service-depth-builder
    environment:
      # Redis connection string
      - REDIS_URL=${REDIS_URL:-redis://redis:6379/0}
      # Logging configuration
      - RUST_LOG=${RUST_LOG:-info}
      # Starting ID for depth calculation
      - START_ID=${DEPTH_START_ID:-0}
    entrypoint: ["/usr/local/bin/depth-builder"]
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped

  # SHYFT-POOL-DEPTH SERVICE - Shyft Pool Depth Updates
  # ===================================================
  # This service periodically updates the Shyft pool depth cache
  # based on the latest data from the Solana blockchain.
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Redis being healthy.
  # It will not start until Redis is ready to accept connections.
  shyft-pool-depth:
    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: crates/shyft-pool-depth/Dockerfile
    image: shyft-pool-depth:latest
    container_name: shyft-pool-depth
    environment:
      # Redis connection string
      - REDIS_URL=${REDIS_URL:-redis://redis:6379/0}
      # Shyft API key for authentication
      - SHYFT_API_KEY=${SHYFT_API_KEY}
      # Logging configuration
      - RUST_LOG=${RUST_LOG:-info}
      # Update interval for Shyft cache
      - UPDATE_INTERVAL=${SHYFT_UPDATE_INTERVAL:-30}
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy

  # =============================================================================
  # STREAMING SERVICES - Solana DEX Data Streaming
  # =============================================================================

  # STREAM-ORCA SERVICE - Solana DEX Data Streamer (Orca)
  # ======================================================
  # This service streams Solana DEX data (Orca) from the blockchain
  # and publishes it to Kafka for real-time processing.
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Redis and Kafka being healthy.
  # It will not start until both are ready.
  stream-orca:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: stream-orca/Dockerfile
      target: runtime
      args:
        BUILDKIT_INLINE_CACHE: 1
    image: arbitrage-stream-orca:latest
    container_name: stream-orca
    env_file:
      - .env
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      # Redis connection string
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379
      # Shyft RPC endpoint and token for data fetching
      - SHYFT_GRPC_ENDPOINT=${SHYFT_GRPC_ENDPOINT}
      - SHYFT_GRPC_TOKEN=${SHYFT_GRPC_TOKEN}
      # Logging configuration
      - LOG_LEVEL=${LOG_LEVEL:-info}
      # Metrics port for monitoring
      - METRICS_PORT=9090
      # Path to IDL files
      - IDL_PATH=/app
      # Logging configuration
      - RUST_LOG=${RUST_LOG:-info}
      # Heartbeat interval for connection monitoring
      - HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL=30
      # Connection timeout for RPC calls
      - CONNECTION_TIMEOUT=30
      # Reconnection delay
      - RECONNECT_DELAY=5
      # Enable timer for periodic updates
      - ENABLE_TIMER=${ENABLE_TIMER:-false}
      # Timer duration for periodic updates
      - TIMER_DURATION_SECONDS=${TIMER_DURATION_SECONDS:-20}
      # Program IDs to monitor
      - PROGRAM_IDS=${PROGRAM_IDS:-whirLbMiicVdio4qvUfM5KAg6Ct8VwpYzGff3uctyCc}
    ports:
      # Metrics port for monitoring
      - "9094:9090"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      # Check if stream-orca process is running
      test: ["CMD", "pgrep", "-f", "stream-orca"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 15s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1G
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'

  # STREAM-RAYDIUM SERVICE - Solana DEX Data Streamer (Raydium)
  # ==========================================================
  # This service streams Solana DEX data (Raydium) from the blockchain
  # and publishes it to Kafka for real-time processing.
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Redis and Kafka being healthy.
  # It will not start until both are ready.
  stream-raydium:
    build:
      context: ../stream-raydium
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      target: runtime
      args:
        BUILDKIT_INLINE_CACHE: 1
    image: arbitrage-stream-raydium:latest
    container_name: stream-raydium
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      # Redis connection string
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379
      # Shyft RPC endpoint and token for data fetching
      - SHYFT_GRPC_ENDPOINT=${SHYFT_GRPC_ENDPOINT}
      - SHYFT_GRPC_TOKEN=${SHYFT_GRPC_TOKEN}
      # Logging configuration
      - LOG_LEVEL=${LOG_LEVEL:-info}
      # Metrics port for monitoring
      - METRICS_PORT=9090
      # Path to IDL files
      - IDL_PATH=/app
      # Logging configuration
      - RUST_LOG=${RUST_LOG:-info}
      # Heartbeat interval for connection monitoring
      - HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL=30
      # Connection timeout for RPC calls
      - CONNECTION_TIMEOUT=30
      # Reconnection delay
      - RECONNECT_DELAY=5
    ports:
      # Metrics port for monitoring
      - "9093:9090"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      # Check if stream-raydium process is running
      test: ["CMD", "pgrep", "-f", "stream-raydium"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 15s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1G
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'

  # =============================================================================
  # PROCESSING SERVICES - Data Processing and Aggregation
  # =============================================================================

  # SWAP-INGEST SERVICE - Solana DEX Swap Data Ingestion
  # =====================================================
  # This service consumes raw Solana DEX swap data from Kafka,
  # validates it, and stores it in Redis for quick retrieval.
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Redis and Kafka being healthy.
  # It will not start until both are ready.
  swap-ingest:
    build:
      context: ../Arbitrage/solana-arbitrage/swap-ingest
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      target: runtime
      args:
        BUILDKIT_INLINE_CACHE: 1
    image: arbitrage-swap-ingest:latest
    container_name: swap-ingest
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
      stream-orca:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      # Redis connection string
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379
      # Logging configuration
      - LOG_LEVEL=${LOG_LEVEL:-info}
      # Minimum profit threshold for alerts
      - MIN_PROFIT_THRESHOLD=${MIN_PROFIT_THRESHOLD:-1.001}
      # Metrics port for monitoring
      - METRICS_PORT=9090
      # Logging configuration
      - RUST_LOG=${RUST_LOG:-info}
      # Heartbeat interval for connection monitoring
      - HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL=30
      # Batch size for processing
      - BATCH_SIZE=50
      # Processing timeout
      - PROCESSING_TIMEOUT=30
    ports:
      # Metrics port for monitoring
      - "9094:9090"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      # Check if swap-ingest process is running
      test: ["CMD", "pgrep", "-f", "swap-ingest"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 15s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1G
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'

  # DATA-STREAM-PROCESSOR SERVICE - Data Stream Processing
  # =====================================================
  # This service continuously processes data streams from Kafka,
  # performs various aggregations, and updates the database.
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Redis and Kafka being healthy.
  # It will not start until both are ready.
  data-stream-processor:
    build:
      context: ../data-stream-processor
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      args:
        BUILDKIT_INLINE_CACHE: 1
    image: data-stream-processor:latest
    container_name: data-stream-processor
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      # Redis connection string
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379
      # Processing interval for data streams
      - PROCESSING_INTERVAL=5
      # Logging configuration
      - RUST_LOG=${RUST_LOG:-info}
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      # Check if data-stream-processor process is running
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "ps aux | grep data-stream-processor | grep -v grep || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 15s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 128M
          cpus: '0.1'

  # PATHFINDER SERVICE - Pathfinding and Arbitrage Calculation
  # =========================================================
  # This service uses the swap data to find profitable trading

  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Swap-Ingest and Data-Stream-Processor

  pathfinder:
    build:
      context: ../Arbitrage/solana-arbitrage/pathfinder
      dockerfile: Dockerfile

      args:
        BUILDKIT_INLINE_CACHE: 1
    image: arbitrage-pathfinder:latest
    container_name: pathfinder
    depends_on:
      swap-ingest:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      # Logging configuration
      - LOG_LEVEL=${LOG_LEVEL:-info}
      # Minimum profit threshold for arbitrage
      - MIN_PROFIT_THRESHOLD=${MIN_PROFIT_THRESHOLD:-1.001}
      # Maximum path length for exploration
      - MAX_PATH_LENGTH=${MAX_PATH_LENGTH:-5}
      # Scan interval for new opportunities
      - SCAN_INTERVAL_SECONDS=${SCAN_INTERVAL_SECONDS:-1}
      # Metrics port for monitoring
      - METRICS_PORT=9090
      # Logging configuration
      - RUST_LOG=${RUST_LOG:-info}
      # Heartbeat interval for connection monitoring
      - HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL=30
      # Maximum concurrent paths to explore
      - MAX_CONCURRENT_PATHS=100
      # Path cache TTL
      - PATH_CACHE_TTL=300
    ports:
      # Metrics port for monitoring
      - "9095:9090"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      # Check if pathfinder process is running
      test: ["CMD", "pgrep", "-f", "pathfinder"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 15s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1G
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'

  # =============================================================================
  # MONITORING & DEBUGGING - Monitoring and Debugging Tools
  # =============================================================================

  # REDIS-VIEWER SERVICE - Redis Data Browser
  # ==========================================
  # This service provides a web-based interface to browse and

  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Redis being healthy.
  # It will not start until Redis is ready.
  redis-viewer:
    build:
      context: ../Arbitrage/solana-arbitrage/redis-viewer
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      args:
        BUILDKIT_INLINE_CACHE: 1
    image: arbitrage-redis-viewer:latest
    container_name: redis-viewer
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      # Redis connection string
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379

      - PORT=5001

  # Prometheus for metrics collection
  prometheus:

    networks:
      - mevana_net

    logging:

  # Grafana for metrics visualization

  # POSTGRES SERVICE - Relational Database
  # ======================================
  # This service provides a PostgreSQL database for:
  # - Storing application data (e.g., user sessions, configurations)
  # - Managing application state and metadata
  # - Supporting complex queries and joins
  # - Serving as a primary data source for the application
  #

  postgres:

      - POSTGRES_INITDB_ARGS=--encoding=UTF8 --lc-collate=C --lc-ctype=C

  # =============================================================================

  # Development service with hot reloading for stream-orca
  stream-orca-dev:

    environment:

      - SHYFT_GRPC_TOKEN=${SHYFT_GRPC_TOKEN}
      # Redis connection string for development
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379
      # Logging configuration for development

  # Price-aggregator SERVICE - Price Data Aggregation
  # ================================================
  # This service consumes normalized swap data from Kafka,
  # performs price calculations, and publishes them to a topic.
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Kafka and Redis being healthy.
  # It will not start until both are ready.
  price-aggregator:
    build:

      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    image: price-aggregator:latest
    container_name: price-aggregator
    environment:
      # Kafka broker connection
      - KAFKA_BROKER=kafka:9092
      # Input topic for normalized swap data
      - IN_TOPIC=${AGG_IN_TOPIC:-orca-swaps.parsed.v2}
      # Output topic for aggregated prices
      - OUT_TOPIC=${AGG_OUT_TOPIC:-prices.latest}
      # Consumer group ID for price aggregation
      - GROUP_ID=${AGG_GROUP_ID:-price-aggregator}
      # Emit interval for price updates
      - EMIT_SECS=${AGG_EMIT_SECS:-5}

  # ARB-TEST-MODE SERVICE - Arbitrage Testing Mode
  # ===============================================
  # This service allows for testing arbitrage strategies
  # without deploying the full trading platform.
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Kafka and Redis being healthy.
  # It will not start until both are ready.
  arb-test-mode:
    build:
      context: ../../crates/arb-test-mode
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    image: arb-test-mode:latest
    container_name: arb-test-mode
    environment:
      # Kafka broker connection
      - KAFKA_BROKER=kafka:9092
      # Input topic for normalized swap data

      - RUST_LOG=${RUST_LOG:-info}

  # UI-GATEWAY SERVICE - Frontend Gateway
  # =====================================
  # This service acts as a reverse proxy and gateway for

  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Kafka and Redis being healthy.
  # It will not start until both are ready.
  ui-gateway:
    build:
      context: ../../crates/ui-gateway
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    image: ui-gateway:latest
    container_name: ui-gateway
    environment:

      - SWAPS_TOPIC=${SWAPS_TOPIC:-orca-swaps.parsed}
      - SWAPS_V2_TOPIC=${SWAPS_V2_TOPIC:-orca-swaps.parsed.v2}
      # Redis connection string
      - REDIS_URL=${REDIS_URL:-redis://redis:6379/0}
      # Logging configuration
      - RUST_LOG=${RUST_LOG:-info}
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped

  # DISCOVERY-SERVICE - AI Program ID Discovery
  # ==========================================
  # This service uses Kafka to discover new Solana program IDs
  # that are not yet registered in the Shyft system.
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Kafka and Redis being healthy.
  # It will not start until both are ready.
  discovery-service:
    build:
      context: ../../crates/discovery-service
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    image: discovery-service:latest
    container_name: discovery-service
    environment:
      # Kafka broker connection
      - KAFKA_BROKER=kafka:9092
      # Redis connection string
      - REDIS_URL=${REDIS_URL:-redis://redis:6379/0}
      # Topic for unknown program IDs
      - UNKNOWN_PROGRAMS_TOPIC=${UNKNOWN_PROGRAMS_TOPIC:-unknown-programs}
      # Logging configuration
      - RUST_LOG=${RUST_LOG:-info}
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:

      - redis

  # SHYFT-VALIDATOR - Enhanced Shyft API Integration Service
  # ======================================================
  # This service watches for Orca/Raydium swap transactions and calls Shyft APIs
  # with a sliding window approach for API readiness.
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Kafka being healthy.
  # It will not start until Kafka is ready.
  #
  # INPUT: orca-swaps.parsed.v2 topic (parsed swap transactions)
  # OUTPUT: shyft-swaps-parsed topic (enriched data with Shyft API results)
  # FEATURES: Sliding window delay for API readiness, DEX program detection
  shyft-validator:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: crates/shyft-validator/Dockerfile
    container_name: shyft-validator
    depends_on:
      kafka:

    environment:
      # Core service configuration
      - RUST_LOG=info
      # Shyft API configuration
      - SHYFT_API_KEY=${SHYFT_API_KEY}
      - SHYFT_NETWORK=mainnet-beta
      # Kafka broker connection
      - KAFKA_BROKER=kafka:9092
      # Health check configuration
      - HEALTH_PORT=8086
      - BIND_ADDRESS=0.0.0.0
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'

  # SHYFT-RAW-PRICE-FEED - Live price feed from Shyft RAW transactions
  # ================================================================
  # Consumes only live RAW transaction data and emits normalized price updates
  shyft-raw-price-feed:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: crates/shyft-raw-price-feed/Dockerfile
    container_name: shyft-raw-price-feed
    depends_on:
      kafka:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      - RUST_LOG=info
      - KAFKA_BROKER=kafka:9092
      - INPUT_TOPIC=shyft-full-transactions-raw
      - OUTPUT_TOPIC=prices.latest.raw
      - GROUP_ID=shyft-raw-price-feed
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 128M
          cpus: '0.10'

  # =============================================================================
  # PARSER SERVICES - Individual DEX Parser Microservices  
  # =============================================================================
  
  # Jupiter Parser Service - Isolated Jupiter V6 Transaction Processing
  jupiter-parser-service:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: crates/jupiter-parser-service/Dockerfile
    container_name: jupiter-parser-service
    profiles: ["parsers", "jupiter"]
    environment:
      - RUST_LOG=${RUST_LOG:-info}

      - BIND_ADDRESS=0.0.0.0
      - KAFKA_BROKERS=kafka:9092
      - KAFKA_TOPIC=dex-transactions
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379
    ports:
      - "8086:8086"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    depends_on:
      kafka:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:8086/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 40s
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "traefik.enable=true"
      - "traefik.http.routers.jupiter-parser.rule=Host(`jupiter-parser.local`)"
      - "traefik.http.services.jupiter-parser.loadbalancer.server.port=8086"

networks:
  mevana_net:
    external: true
    name: mevana_net

volumes:
  postgres_data:
    driver: local
  prometheus_data:
    driver: local
  grafana_data:
    driver: local
  cargo_cache:
    driver: local
  target_cache:
    driver: local
```

```rust
use anyhow::Result;
use clap::Parser;
use dotenv::dotenv;
use env_logger::Env;
use log::{error, info};
use rdkafka::config::ClientConfig;
use rdkafka::producer::{FutureProducer, FutureRecord};
use redis::aio::MultiplexedConnection;
use redis::AsyncCommands;
use serde::Serialize;
use solana_client::rpc_client::RpcClient;
use solana_sdk::pubkey::Pubkey;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::str::FromStr;
use std::time::Duration;
use tokio::time::interval;
use whirlpool_core::{
    quoter::ClmmQuoter,
    quoter::Direction,
    tick_window::{TickArrayView, TickWindow},
    types::Tick,
};

#[derive(Parser, Debug, Clone)]
#[command(name = "whirlpool-quote-surface", version)]
struct Args {
    #[arg(long, env = "REDIS_URL", default_value = "redis://localhost:6379/0")]
    redis_url: String,

    #[arg(long, env = "KAFKA_BROKERS", default_value = "localhost:29092")]
    kafka_brokers: String,

    #[arg(long, env = "OUT_TOPIC", default_value = "quotes.whirlpool.v1")]
    out_topic: String,

    #[arg(long, env = "QUOTE_SIZES", default_value = "100,1000,10000")]
    quote_sizes: String,

    #[arg(long, env = "QUOTE_INTERVAL_MS", default_value_t = 1000)]
    quote_interval_ms: u64,

    #[arg(
        long,
        env = "RPC_URL",
        default_value = "https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com"
    )]
    rpc_url: String,
}

#[derive(Serialize)]
struct QuoteOut {
    pool: String,
    side: String,
    size_in: u128,
    out: u128,
    ticks_crossed: u32,
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
    dotenv().ok();
    env_logger::init_from_env(Env::default().default_filter_or("info"));

    let args = Args::parse();
    info!("Starting whirlpool-quote-surface → {}", args.out_topic);

    let redis_client = redis::Client::open(args.redis_url.clone())?;
    let mut redis_conn = redis_client.get_multiplexed_async_connection().await?;
    let rpc = RpcClient::new(args.rpc_url.clone());

    let producer: FutureProducer = ClientConfig::new()
        .set("bootstrap.servers", &args.kafka_brokers)
        .create()?;

    let mut ticker = interval(Duration::from_millis(args.quote_interval_ms));
    let sizes: Vec<u128> = args
        .quote_sizes
        .split(',')
        .filter_map(|s| s.trim().parse::<u128>().ok())
        .collect();

    // Simple decimals cache
    let mut mint_decimals: HashMap<String, u8> = HashMap::new();

    loop {
        ticker.tick().await;

        // Enumerate available Whirlpool pools from Redis (dev: KEYS; prod: SCAN)
        let keys: Vec<String> = redis::cmd("KEYS")
            .arg("whirlpool:pool:*")
            .query_async(&mut redis_conn)
            .await
            .unwrap_or_default();

        // SCAN returns a vector; we keep a small sample
        for key in keys
            .into_iter()
            .filter(|k| k.starts_with("whirlpool:pool:"))
            .take(10)
        {
            let pool = key.trim_start_matches("whirlpool:pool:").to_string();
            let raw: Option<String> = redis::cmd("GET")
                .arg(&key)
                .query_async(&mut redis_conn)
                .await
                .ok();
            let Some(raw_json) = raw else { continue };
            let v: serde_json::Value =
                serde_json::from_str(&raw_json).unwrap_or(serde_json::json!({}));
            let sqrt_price_x64 = v
                .get("sqrt_price_x64")
                .and_then(|x| x.as_str())
                .and_then(|s| s.parse::<u128>().ok())
                .unwrap_or(0);
            let liquidity = v
                .get("liquidity")
                .and_then(|x| x.as_str())
                .and_then(|s| s.parse::<u128>().ok())
                .unwrap_or(0);
            let tick_current = v.get("tick_current").and_then(|x| x.as_i64()).unwrap_or(0) as i32;
            let tick_spacing = v.get("tick_spacing").and_then(|x| x.as_i64()).unwrap_or(64) as i32;
            let fee_bps = v.get("fee_bps").and_then(|x| x.as_i64()).unwrap_or(30) as u16;

            // Decimals lookup for token mints
            let token_a = v
                .get("token_a")
                .and_then(|x| x.as_str())
                .unwrap_or("")
                .to_string();
            let token_b = v
                .get("token_b")
                .and_then(|x| x.as_str())
                .unwrap_or("")
                .to_string();
            let _dec_a = get_or_fetch_decimals(&rpc, &mut mint_decimals, &mut redis_conn, &token_a)
                .await
                .unwrap_or(6);
            let _dec_b = get_or_fetch_decimals(&rpc, &mut mint_decimals, &mut redis_conn, &token_b)
                .await
                .unwrap_or(6);

            // Assemble a TickWindow from Redis tick-array summaries
            let window = match build_tick_window_from_redis(&mut redis_conn, &v, &pool, tick_spacing).await {
                Some(w) => w,
                None => TickWindow::default(),
            };
            let quoter = ClmmQuoter {
                sqrt_price_x64,
                liquidity,
                tick_current,
                tick_spacing,
                total_fee_bps: fee_bps,
                window,
            };

            for &sz in &sizes {
                for (dir, side) in [(Direction::AtoB, "AtoB"), (Direction::BtoA, "BtoA")] {
                    let q = quoter.quote(dir, sz, 1);
                    let out = QuoteOut {
                        pool: pool.clone(),
                        side: side.to_string(),
                        size_in: sz,
                        out: q.out,
                        ticks_crossed: q.ticks_crossed,
                    };

                        .send(
                            FutureRecord::<(), _>::to(&args.out_topic).payload(&payload),
                            Duration::from_secs(5),
                        )
                        .await;
                }
            }
        }

        info!("Emitted quotes batch");
    }
}

async fn build_tick_window_from_redis(
    redis_conn: &mut MultiplexedConnection,
    pool_json: &serde_json::Value,
    pool_b58: &str,
    tick_spacing: i32,
) -> Option<TickWindow<'static>> {
    let starts = pool_json
        .get("tick_array_starts")?
        .as_array()?;
    if starts.len() != 3 {
        return None;
    }
    let start_vals: Vec<i32> = starts
        .iter()
        .filter_map(|x| x.as_i64())
        .map(|x| x as i32)
        .collect();
    if start_vals.len() != 3 {
        return None;
    }

    // Helper to fetch initialized indices for a start
    async fn fetch_init_indices(
        conn: &mut MultiplexedConnection,
        pool: &str,
        start: i32,
    ) -> Option<Vec<i32>> {
        let key = format!("whirlpool:tickarray:{}:{}", start, pool);
        let raw: String = redis::cmd("GET").arg(&key).query_async(conn).await.ok()?;
        let v: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&raw).ok()?;
        let arr = v.get("initialized_indices")?.as_array()?;
        Some(
            arr.iter()
                .filter_map(|x| x.as_i64())
                .map(|x| x as i32)
                .collect(),
        )
    }

    // Build three arrays; we must own the memory backing TickArrayView
    let mut lower_ticks: [Tick; 88] = std::array::from_fn(|_| Tick {
        liquidity_net: 0,
        liquidity_gross: 0,
        fee_growth_outside_a: 0,
        fee_growth_outside_b: 0,
        reward_growths_outside: [0, 0, 0],
    });
    let mut current_ticks = lower_ticks.clone();
    let mut upper_ticks = lower_ticks.clone();

    // Populate initialized flags based on indices
    if let Some(idxs) = fetch_init_indices(redis_conn, pool_b58, start_vals[0]).await {
        for abs_tick in idxs {
            let off = (abs_tick - start_vals[0]) / tick_spacing;
            if off >= 0 && off < 88 {
                lower_ticks[off as usize].liquidity_gross = 1;
            }
        }
    }
    if let Some(idxs) = fetch_init_indices(redis_conn, pool_b58, start_vals[1]).await {
        for abs_tick in idxs {
            let off = (abs_tick - start_vals[1]) / tick_spacing;
            if off >= 0 && off < 88 {
                current_ticks[off as usize].liquidity_gross = 1;
            }
        }
    }
    if let Some(idxs) = fetch_init_indices(redis_conn, pool_b58, start_vals[2]).await {
        for abs_tick in idxs {
            let off = (abs_tick - start_vals[2]) / tick_spacing;
            if off >= 0 && off < 88 {
                upper_ticks[off as usize].liquidity_gross = 1;
            }
        }
    }

    // Leak arrays to obtain 'static refs for TickWindow lifetime within this call
    let lower_box = Box::new(lower_ticks);
    let current_box = Box::new(current_ticks);
    let upper_box = Box::new(upper_ticks);
    let lower_ref: &'static [Tick; 88] = Box::leak(lower_box);
    let current_ref: &'static [Tick; 88] = Box::leak(current_box);
    let upper_ref: &'static [Tick; 88] = Box::leak(upper_box);

    Some(TickWindow {
        lower: Some(TickArrayView {
            start_tick_index: start_vals[0],
            ticks: lower_ref,
        }),
        current: Some(TickArrayView {
            start_tick_index: start_vals[1],
            ticks: current_ref,
        }),
        upper: Some(TickArrayView {
            start_tick_index: start_vals[2],
            ticks: upper_ref,
        }),
    })
}

async fn get_or_fetch_decimals(
    rpc: &RpcClient,
    cache: &mut HashMap<String, u8>,
    redis_conn: &mut MultiplexedConnection,
    mint_b58: &str,
) -> Option<u8> {
    if mint_b58.is_empty() {
        return None;
    }
    if let Some(&d) = cache.get(mint_b58) {
        return Some(d);
    }
    // Try Redis first
    let key = format!("mint:decimals:{}", mint_b58);
    if let Ok(Some(s)) = redis::cmd("GET")
        .arg(&key)
        .query_async::<_, Option<String>>(redis_conn)
        .await
    {
        if let Ok(val) = s.parse::<u8>() {
            cache.insert(mint_b58.to_string(), val);
            return Some(val);
        }
    }
    // Fallback to RPC
    let pk = Pubkey::from_str(mint_b58).ok()?;
    let acc = rpc.get_account(&pk).ok()?;
    if acc.data.len() >= 45 {
        let dec = acc.data[44];
        cache.insert(mint_b58.to_string(), dec);
        let _: Result<(), _> = redis::cmd("SETEX")
            .arg(&key)
            .arg(3600)
            .arg(dec.to_string())
            .query_async::<_, ()>(redis_conn)
            .await;
        Some(dec)
    } else {
        None
    }
}
```

```rust
            .query_async(&mut redis_conn)

            let tick_current = v.get("tick_current").and_then(|x| x.as_i64()).unwrap_or(0) as i32;

                .await
                .unwrap_or(6);
            let _dec_b = get_or_fetch_decimals(&rpc, &mut mint_decimals, &mut redis_conn, &token_b)
                .await
                .unwrap_or(6);

            // Assemble a TickWindow from Redis tick-array summaries
            let window = match build_tick_window_from_redis(&mut redis_conn, &v, &pool, tick_spacing).await {

fn floor_div_i32(x: i32, y: i32) -> i32 {
    let mut q = x / y;
    if (x ^ y) < 0 && x % y != 0 { q -= 1; }
    q
}
fn ceil_div_i32(x: i32, y: i32) -> i32 {
    let mut q = x / y;
    if (x ^ y) >= 0 && x % y != 0 { q += 1; }
    q
}

fn fallback_one_grid_step(
    dir: Direction,
    dx_in: u128,
    sp_current: u128,
    liquidity: u128,
    tick_current: i32,
    tick_spacing: i32,
    fee_bps: u16,
) -> Option<u128> {
    if dx_in == 0 || sp_current == 0 || tick_spacing <= 0 { return None; }
    let boundary_tick = match dir {
        Direction::AtoB => floor_div_i32(tick_current, tick_spacing) * tick_spacing,
        Direction::BtoA => ceil_div_i32(tick_current + 1, tick_spacing) * tick_spacing,
    };
    let sp_next = tick_to_sqrt_price_x64_approx(boundary_tick);
    match dir {
        Direction::AtoB => {
            if sp_next == 0 || sp_next >= sp_current { return None; }
            let max_dx_raw = dx_raw_within_tick_ab(sp_current, sp_next, liquidity);
            if max_dx_raw == 0 { return None; }
            let max_dx_in = apply_input_fee(max_dx_raw, fee_bps);
            let dx_clip = dx_in.min(max_dx_in);
            let fee_denom = 10_000u64;
            let fee_num = (fee_denom - fee_bps as u64) as u128;
            let dx_eff_clip = (dx_clip as u128) * fee_num / (fee_denom as u128);
            let dy_raw = (liquidity as u128)
                .saturating_mul(sp_current.saturating_sub(sp_next))
                .saturating_mul(dx_eff_clip)
                / max_dx_raw;
            Some(dy_raw)
        }
        Direction::BtoA => {
            if sp_next <= sp_current { return None; }
            let max_dy_raw = dy_raw_within_tick_ba(sp_current, sp_next, liquidity);
            if max_dy_raw == 0 { return None; }
            let max_dx_in = apply_input_fee(max_dy_raw, fee_bps);
            let dx_clip = dx_in.min(max_dx_in);
            let fee_denom = 10_000u64;
            let fee_num = (fee_denom - fee_bps as u64) as u128;
            let dx_eff_clip = (dx_clip as u128) * fee_num / (fee_denom as u128);
            let num = (liquidity as u128)
                .saturating_mul(sp_next.saturating_sub(sp_current))
                .saturating_mul(dx_eff_clip);
            let dy_out = if max_dy_raw > 0 { num / max_dy_raw } else { 0 };
            Some(dy_out)
        }
    }
}

    redis_conn: &mut MultiplexedConnection,

    let mut current_ticks = lower_ticks.clone();

            if off >= 0 && off < 88 {
                upper_ticks[off as usize].liquidity_gross = 1;
            }
        }
    }

    // Leak arrays to obtain 'static refs for TickWindow lifetime within this call
    let lower_box = Box::new(lower_ticks);
    let current_box = Box::new(current_ticks);
    let upper_box = Box::new(upper_ticks);

    let current_ref: &'static [Tick; 88] = Box::leak(current_box);
    let upper_ref: &'static [Tick; 88] = Box::leak(upper_box);

    Some(TickWindow {
```

```rust
use anyhow::Result;
use clap::Parser;
use dotenv::dotenv;
use env_logger::Env;
use log::{error, info};
use rdkafka::config::ClientConfig;
use rdkafka::producer::{FutureProducer, FutureRecord};
use redis::aio::MultiplexedConnection;
use redis::AsyncCommands;
use serde::Serialize;
use solana_client::rpc_client::RpcClient;
use solana_sdk::pubkey::Pubkey;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::str::FromStr;
use std::time::Duration;
use tokio::time::interval;
use whirlpool_core::math::{
    apply_input_fee, dx_raw_within_tick_ab, dy_raw_within_tick_ba, tick_to_sqrt_price_x64_approx,
};
use whirlpool_core::{
    quoter::ClmmQuoter,
    quoter::Direction,
    tick_window::{TickArrayView, TickWindow},
    types::Tick,
};

#[derive(Parser, Debug, Clone)]
#[command(name = "whirlpool-quote-surface", version)]
struct Args {
    #[arg(long, env = "REDIS_URL", default_value = "redis://localhost:6379/0")]
    redis_url: String,

    #[arg(long, env = "KAFKA_BROKERS", default_value = "localhost:29092")]
    kafka_brokers: String,

    #[arg(long, env = "OUT_TOPIC", default_value = "quotes.whirlpool.v1")]
    out_topic: String,

    #[arg(long, env = "QUOTE_SIZES", default_value = "100,1000,10000")]
    quote_sizes: String,

    #[arg(long, env = "QUOTE_INTERVAL_MS", default_value_t = 1000)]
    quote_interval_ms: u64,

    #[arg(
        long,
        env = "RPC_URL",
        default_value = "https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com"
    )]
    rpc_url: String,

    #[arg(long, env = "MIN_LIQUIDITY", default_value_t = 0u128)]
    min_liquidity: u128,

    #[arg(long, env = "QUOTE_POOL_ALLOWLIST", default_value = "")]
    quote_pool_allowlist: String,
}

#[derive(Serialize)]
struct QuoteOut {
    pool: String,
    side: String,
    size_in: u128,
    out: u128,
    ticks_crossed: u32,
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
    dotenv().ok();
    env_logger::init_from_env(Env::default().default_filter_or("info"));

    let args = Args::parse();
    info!("Starting whirlpool-quote-surface → {}", args.out_topic);

    let redis_client = redis::Client::open(args.redis_url.clone())?;
    let mut redis_conn = redis_client.get_multiplexed_async_connection().await?;
    let rpc = RpcClient::new(args.rpc_url.clone());

    let producer: FutureProducer = ClientConfig::new()
        .set("bootstrap.servers", &args.kafka_brokers)
        .create()?;

    let mut ticker = interval(Duration::from_millis(args.quote_interval_ms));
    let sizes: Vec<u128> = args
        .quote_sizes
        .split(',')
        .filter_map(|s| s.trim().parse::<u128>().ok())
        .collect();

    // Simple decimals cache
    let mut mint_decimals: HashMap<String, u8> = HashMap::new();
    let allowlist: std::collections::HashSet<String> = args
        .quote_pool_allowlist
        .split(',')
        .filter_map(|s| {
            let t = s.trim();
            if t.is_empty() { None } else { Some(t.to_string()) }
        })
        .collect();

    loop {
        ticker.tick().await;

        // Enumerate available Whirlpool pools from Redis (dev: KEYS; prod: SCAN)
        let keys: Vec<String> = redis::cmd("KEYS")
            .arg("whirlpool:pool:*")
            .query_async(&mut redis_conn)
            .await
            .unwrap_or_default();

        // SCAN returns a vector; we keep a small sample
        for key in keys
            .into_iter()
            .filter(|k| k.starts_with("whirlpool:pool:"))
            .take(10)
        {
            let pool = key.trim_start_matches("whirlpool:pool:").to_string();
            let raw: Option<String> = redis::cmd("GET")
                .arg(&key)
                .query_async(&mut redis_conn)
                .await
                .ok();
            let Some(raw_json) = raw else { continue };
            let v: serde_json::Value =
                serde_json::from_str(&raw_json).unwrap_or(serde_json::json!({}));
            let sqrt_price_x64 = v
                .get("sqrt_price_x64")
                .and_then(|x| x.as_str())
                .and_then(|s| s.parse::<u128>().ok())
                .unwrap_or(0);
            let liquidity = v
                .get("liquidity")
                .and_then(|x| x.as_str())
                .and_then(|s| s.parse::<u128>().ok())
                .unwrap_or(0);
            let tick_current = v.get("tick_current").and_then(|x| x.as_i64()).unwrap_or(0) as i32;
            let tick_spacing = v.get("tick_spacing").and_then(|x| x.as_i64()).unwrap_or(64) as i32;
            let fee_bps = v.get("fee_bps").and_then(|x| x.as_i64()).unwrap_or(30) as u16;

            // Active pool filter: liquidity threshold and at least one initialized tick
            if liquidity < args.min_liquidity && !allowlist.contains(&pool) {
                continue;
            }

            // Decimals lookup for token mints
            let token_a = v
                .get("token_a")
                .and_then(|x| x.as_str())
                .unwrap_or("")
                .to_string();
            let token_b = v
                .get("token_b")
                .and_then(|x| x.as_str())
                .unwrap_or("")
                .to_string();
            let _dec_a = get_or_fetch_decimals(&rpc, &mut mint_decimals, &mut redis_conn, &token_a)
                .await
                .unwrap_or(6);
            let _dec_b = get_or_fetch_decimals(&rpc, &mut mint_decimals, &mut redis_conn, &token_b)
                .await
                .unwrap_or(6);

            // Assemble a TickWindow from Redis tick-array summaries
            let window = match build_tick_window_from_redis(
                &mut redis_conn,
                &v,
                &pool,
                tick_spacing,
            )
            .await
            {
                Some(w) => w,
                None => TickWindow::default(),
            };
            // If not allowlisted, skip pools with no initialized ticks across window
            if window.current.is_none() && !allowlist.contains(&pool) {
                continue;
            }
            let quoter = ClmmQuoter {
                sqrt_price_x64,
                liquidity,
                tick_current,
                tick_spacing,
                total_fee_bps: fee_bps,
                window,
            };

            for &sz in &sizes {
                for (dir, side) in [(Direction::AtoB, "AtoB"), (Direction::BtoA, "BtoA")] {
                    let mut q = quoter.quote(dir, sz, 1);
                    if q.out == 0 {
                        if let Some(fallback_out) = fallback_one_grid_step(
                            dir,
                            sz,
                            quoter.sqrt_price_x64,
                            quoter.liquidity,
                            quoter.tick_current,
                            quoter.tick_spacing,
                            quoter.total_fee_bps,
                        ) {
                            q.out = fallback_out;
                        }
                    }
                    let out = QuoteOut {
                        pool: pool.clone(),
                        side: side.to_string(),
                        size_in: sz,
                        out: q.out,
                        ticks_crossed: q.ticks_crossed,
                    };
                    let payload = serde_json::to_string(&out)?;
                    let _ = producer
                        .send(
                            FutureRecord::<(), _>::to(&args.out_topic).payload(&payload),
                            Duration::from_secs(5),
                        )
                        .await;
                }
            }
        }

        info!("Emitted quotes batch");
    }
}

fn floor_div_i32(x: i32, y: i32) -> i32 {
    let mut q = x / y;
    if (x ^ y) < 0 && x % y != 0 {
        q -= 1;
    }
    q
}
fn ceil_div_i32(x: i32, y: i32) -> i32 {
    let mut q = x / y;
    if (x ^ y) >= 0 && x % y != 0 {
        q += 1;
    }
    q
}

fn fallback_one_grid_step(
    dir: Direction,
    dx_in: u128,
    sp_current: u128,
    liquidity: u128,
    tick_current: i32,
    tick_spacing: i32,
    fee_bps: u16,
) -> Option<u128> {
    if dx_in == 0 || sp_current == 0 || tick_spacing <= 0 {
        return None;
    }
    let boundary_tick = match dir {
        Direction::AtoB => floor_div_i32(tick_current, tick_spacing) * tick_spacing,
        Direction::BtoA => ceil_div_i32(tick_current + 1, tick_spacing) * tick_spacing,
    };
    let sp_next = tick_to_sqrt_price_x64_approx(boundary_tick);
    match dir {
        Direction::AtoB => {
            if sp_next == 0 || sp_next >= sp_current {
                return None;
            }
            let max_dx_raw = dx_raw_within_tick_ab(sp_current, sp_next, liquidity);
            if max_dx_raw == 0 {
                return None;
            }
            let max_dx_in = apply_input_fee(max_dx_raw, fee_bps);
            let dx_clip = dx_in.min(max_dx_in);
            let fee_denom = 10_000u64;
            let fee_num = (fee_denom - fee_bps as u64) as u128;
            let dx_eff_clip = (dx_clip as u128) * fee_num / (fee_denom as u128);
            let dy_raw = (liquidity as u128)
                .saturating_mul(sp_current.saturating_sub(sp_next))
                .saturating_mul(dx_eff_clip)
                / max_dx_raw;
            Some(dy_raw)
        }
        Direction::BtoA => {
            if sp_next <= sp_current {
                return None;
            }
            let max_dy_raw = dy_raw_within_tick_ba(sp_current, sp_next, liquidity);
            if max_dy_raw == 0 {
                return None;
            }
            let max_dx_in = apply_input_fee(max_dy_raw, fee_bps);
            let dx_clip = dx_in.min(max_dx_in);
            let fee_denom = 10_000u64;
            let fee_num = (fee_denom - fee_bps as u64) as u128;
            let dx_eff_clip = (dx_clip as u128) * fee_num / (fee_denom as u128);
            let num = (liquidity as u128)
                .saturating_mul(sp_next.saturating_sub(sp_current))
                .saturating_mul(dx_eff_clip);
            let dy_out = if max_dy_raw > 0 { num / max_dy_raw } else { 0 };
            Some(dy_out)
        }
    }
}

async fn build_tick_window_from_redis(
    redis_conn: &mut MultiplexedConnection,
    pool_json: &serde_json::Value,
    pool_b58: &str,
    tick_spacing: i32,
) -> Option<TickWindow<'static>> {
    let starts = pool_json.get("tick_array_starts")?.as_array()?;
    if starts.len() != 3 {
        return None;
    }
    let start_vals: Vec<i32> = starts
        .iter()
        .filter_map(|x| x.as_i64())
        .map(|x| x as i32)
        .collect();
    if start_vals.len() != 3 {
        return None;
    }

    // Helper to fetch initialized indices for a start
    async fn fetch_init_indices(
        conn: &mut MultiplexedConnection,
        pool: &str,
        start: i32,
    ) -> Option<Vec<i32>> {
        let key = format!("whirlpool:tickarray:{}:{}", start, pool);
        let raw: String = redis::cmd("GET").arg(&key).query_async(conn).await.ok()?;
        let v: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&raw).ok()?;
        let arr = v.get("initialized_indices")?.as_array()?;
        Some(
            arr.iter()
                .filter_map(|x| x.as_i64())
                .map(|x| x as i32)
                .collect(),
        )
    }

    // Build three arrays; we must own the memory backing TickArrayView
    let mut lower_ticks: [Tick; 88] = std::array::from_fn(|_| Tick {
        liquidity_net: 0,
        liquidity_gross: 0,
        fee_growth_outside_a: 0,
        fee_growth_outside_b: 0,
        reward_growths_outside: [0, 0, 0],
    });
    let mut current_ticks = lower_ticks.clone();
    let mut upper_ticks = lower_ticks.clone();

    // Populate initialized flags based on indices
    if let Some(idxs) = fetch_init_indices(redis_conn, pool_b58, start_vals[0]).await {
        for abs_tick in idxs {
            let off = (abs_tick - start_vals[0]) / tick_spacing;
            if off >= 0 && off < 88 {
                lower_ticks[off as usize].liquidity_gross = 1;
            }
        }
    }
    if let Some(idxs) = fetch_init_indices(redis_conn, pool_b58, start_vals[1]).await {
        for abs_tick in idxs {
            let off = (abs_tick - start_vals[1]) / tick_spacing;
            if off >= 0 && off < 88 {
                current_ticks[off as usize].liquidity_gross = 1;
            }
        }
    }
    if let Some(idxs) = fetch_init_indices(redis_conn, pool_b58, start_vals[2]).await {
        for abs_tick in idxs {
            let off = (abs_tick - start_vals[2]) / tick_spacing;
            if off >= 0 && off < 88 {
                upper_ticks[off as usize].liquidity_gross = 1;
            }
        }
    }

    // Leak arrays to obtain 'static refs for TickWindow lifetime within this call
    let lower_box = Box::new(lower_ticks);
    let current_box = Box::new(current_ticks);
    let upper_box = Box::new(upper_ticks);
    let lower_ref: &'static [Tick; 88] = Box::leak(lower_box);
    let current_ref: &'static [Tick; 88] = Box::leak(current_box);
    let upper_ref: &'static [Tick; 88] = Box::leak(upper_box);

    Some(TickWindow {
        lower: Some(TickArrayView {
            start_tick_index: start_vals[0],
            ticks: lower_ref,
        }),
        current: Some(TickArrayView {
            start_tick_index: start_vals[1],
            ticks: current_ref,
        }),
        upper: Some(TickArrayView {
            start_tick_index: start_vals[2],
            ticks: upper_ref,
        }),
    })
}

async fn get_or_fetch_decimals(
    rpc: &RpcClient,
    cache: &mut HashMap<String, u8>,
    redis_conn: &mut MultiplexedConnection,
    mint_b58: &str,
) -> Option<u8> {
    if mint_b58.is_empty() {
        return None;
    }
    if let Some(&d) = cache.get(mint_b58) {
        return Some(d);
    }
    // Try Redis first
    let key = format!("mint:decimals:{}", mint_b58);
    if let Ok(Some(s)) = redis::cmd("GET")
        .arg(&key)
        .query_async::<_, Option<String>>(redis_conn)
        .await
    {
        if let Ok(val) = s.parse::<u8>() {
            cache.insert(mint_b58.to_string(), val);
            return Some(val);
        }
    }
    // Fallback to RPC
    let pk = Pubkey::from_str(mint_b58).ok()?;
    let acc = rpc.get_account(&pk).ok()?;
    if acc.data.len() >= 45 {
        let dec = acc.data[44];
        cache.insert(mint_b58.to_string(), dec);
        let _: Result<(), _> = redis::cmd("SETEX")
            .arg(&key)
            .arg(3600)
            .arg(dec.to_string())
            .query_async::<_, ()>(redis_conn)
            .await;
        Some(dec)
    } else {
        None
    }
}
```

```dockercompose
# =============================================================================
# SOLANA AI TRADING PLATFORM - ENHANCED DOCKER COMPOSE
# =============================================================================
# Enhanced version with improved connectivity, monitoring, and resource management
#
# NETWORK ARCHITECTURE OVERVIEW:
# =============================
# This compose file establishes a complete infrastructure foundation for the MEVana
# trading platform. Services are deployed in dependency order with proper health
# checks to ensure reliable startup sequences.
#
# DEPLOYMENT ORDER (CRITICAL):
# 1. Zookeeper (2181) - Kafka coordination service
# 2. Kafka (9092/29092) - Message broker (depends on Zookeeper)
# 3. Kafka-UI (8080) - Management interface (depends on Kafka)
# 4. Redis (6379) - Data caching service
# 5. Redis-UI (8083) - Management interface (depends on Redis)
#
# NETWORK ISOLATION:
# - All services use 'mevana_net' external network
# - Internal communication via Docker DNS (e.g., kafka:9092)
# - External access via localhost ports for development
#
# HEALTH CHECK STRATEGY:
# - Zookeeper: Basic connectivity test
# - Kafka: Topic listing capability
# - Redis: Ping/incr operation
# - UI Services: HTTP endpoint availability
#
# RESOURCE MANAGEMENT:
# - Memory and CPU limits set for production stability
# - Log rotation configured to prevent disk space issues
# - Graceful restart policies for service recovery
# =============================================================================

services:
  # =============================================================================
  # INFRASTRUCTURE SERVICES - CORE MESSAGE BROKER STACK
  # =============================================================================
  
  # ZOOKEEPER SERVICE - Kafka Coordination Foundation
  # ================================================
  # Zookeeper is the coordination service that Kafka requires for:
  # - Leader election and failover
  # - Configuration management
  # - Distributed synchronization
  # - Service discovery
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service MUST start first and be healthy before Kafka
  # can initialize. All Kafka operations depend on Zookeeper availability.
  zookeeper:
    image: confluentinc/cp-zookeeper:7.4.0
    container_name: zookeeper
    environment:
      # Client connection port - used by Kafka and other services
      ZOOKEEPER_CLIENT_PORT: 2181
      # Heartbeat interval in milliseconds
      ZOOKEEPER_TICK_TIME: 2000
      # Autopurge settings to limit snapshot/log growth
      # Retain the last 3 snapshots; purge every 24 hours
      ZOOKEEPER_AUTOPURGE_SNAP_RETAIN_COUNT: 3
      ZOOKEEPER_AUTOPURGE_PURGE_INTERVAL: 24
      # Maximum number of client connections
      ZOOKEEPER_MAX_CLIENT_CNXNS: 60
      # Sync limit for follower synchronization
      ZOOKEEPER_SYNC_LIMIT: 2
      # Initial limit for leader election
      ZOOKEEPER_INIT_LIMIT: 5
    healthcheck:
      # Test Zookeeper connectivity by attempting a basic operation
      test: ["CMD", "bash", "-c", "echo stat | nc localhost 2181"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 10s
    ports:
      # Expose Zookeeper port for external monitoring and debugging
      - "2181:2181"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'

  # KAFKA SERVICE - Message Broker Core
  # ===================================
  # Kafka is the central message broker that handles:
  # - High-throughput message streaming
  # - Topic management and partitioning
  # - Consumer group coordination
  # - Message persistence and replication
  #
  # CRITICAL: This service depends on Zookeeper being healthy.
  # Kafka will not start until Zookeeper reports healthy status.
  # All application services depend on Kafka availability.
  kafka:
    image: confluentinc/cp-kafka:7.4.0
    container_name: kafka
    depends_on:
      zookeeper:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      # Unique broker identifier in the cluster
      KAFKA_BROKER_ID: 1
      # Zookeeper connection string for coordination
      KAFKA_ZOOKEEPER_CONNECT: zookeeper:2181
      # Network listeners configuration
      # PLAINTEXT://0.0.0.0:9092 - Internal Docker network listener
      # PLAINTEXT_HOST://0.0.0.0:29092 - External host access listener
      KAFKA_LISTENERS: PLAINTEXT://0.0.0.0:9092,PLAINTEXT_HOST://0.0.0.0:29092
      # Advertised listeners for client connections
      # PLAINTEXT://kafka:9092 - Internal Docker DNS name
      # PLAINTEXT_HOST://localhost:29092 - External localhost access
      KAFKA_ADVERTISED_LISTENERS: PLAINTEXT://kafka:9092,PLAINTEXT_HOST://localhost:29092
      # Security protocol mapping for each listener
      KAFKA_LISTENER_SECURITY_PROTOCOL_MAP: PLAINTEXT:PLAINTEXT,PLAINTEXT_HOST:PLAINTEXT
      # Internal broker communication listener
      KAFKA_INTER_BROKER_LISTENER_NAME: PLAINTEXT
      # Enable automatic topic creation for development
      KAFKA_AUTO_CREATE_TOPICS_ENABLE: "true"
      # Replication factor for system topics
      KAFKA_OFFSETS_TOPIC_REPLICATION_FACTOR: 1
      # JVM heap configuration for performance
      KAFKA_HEAP_OPTS: "-Xmx1G -Xms1G"
      # Log retention policy (7 days)
      KAFKA_LOG_RETENTION_HOURS: 168
      # Log segment size for efficient storage
      KAFKA_LOG_SEGMENT_BYTES: 1073741824
```
